AI.method: 方法论层面借鉴四类经典思想并迁移到 AI 上下文结构化问题：(1) Unix 管道哲学（McIlroy 的"每个程序只做一件事"、文本流作为通用接口、Kernighan & Pike 的模块化/透明/组合规则、Shaw & Garlan 的 pipe-and-filter 模式）；(2) 构建系统传统（Make 的文件依赖图、多趟编译中每趟读取上一趟输出并有明确接口）；(3) Parnas 的信息隐藏模块化与 Dijkstra 的关注点分离；(4) literate programming。同时引入 Karpathy 的"上下文工程"概念与 Lance Martin 的 write/select/compress/isolate 策略分类，强调 ICM 采用"预防式"的分层加载而非事后压缩。设计上提出五项原则：One stage, one job；Plain text as the interface；Layered context loading；Every output is an edit surface；Configure the factory, not the product。实例化结构为五层上下文层级：Layer 0 CLAUDE.md（全局身份/我身处何地，~800 tok）、Layer 1 CONTEXT.md（任务路由/该往哪走，~300 tok）、Layer 2 各阶段 CONTEXT.md（阶段契约：Inputs 表、Process、Outputs，200–500 tok）、Layer 3 参考资料（voice.md、design-system.md 等，跨运行稳定的"工厂"，500–2k tok）、Layer 4 工作产物（上一阶段 output/ 等，每次运行变化的"产品"，通常几千 tok）。阶段契约的 Inputs 表显式、可编辑、可审计地规定该阶段加载哪些 Layer 3/4 文件及哪些小节；Layer 3 大型集合内还可递归嵌套 CONTEXT.md 作为路由文件。状态管理、阶段排序、上下文裁剪全部由文件系统承担，代码只保留确定性的本地 Python 脚本（抓取、移动文件、格式化、发邮件）。理论依据还来自人机交互与监管研究：Fails & Olsen 的交互式机器学习、Horvitz 的混合主动系统（自然断点处可调用/调整/终止）、Parasuraman & Riley 的误用/弃用失效模式、Lee & See 的信任校准、Shneiderman 的人类中心 AI、Rudin 的内生可解释性主张，以及 EU AI Act 对人类监督与审计轨迹的要求。
AI.result: 文中以脚本转动画工作区为例给出代表性 token 计量：ICM 三个阶段（Research/Script/Production）各自交付约 5.6k / 5.5k / 4.9k tokens 的聚焦上下文；而把全部阶段指令、全部参考材料与全部历史输出载入单个提示的单体式方案约需 42k tokens，其中绝大部分属于"当前步骤不使用的无关上下文"。ICM 总上下文落在 2k–8k 区间，被作者认为是当前模型表现最佳的范围。论文给出十个维度的对照表（阶段顺序调整、提示修改、阶段增删、中间状态检视、交接他人、变更者权限、流水线中途错误恢复、条件分支、并发执行、外部服务集成）：前六项文件夹方案显著更简单，后四项为框架方案占优。文中强调 ICM 相对 Anthropic MCP 是互补分层（ICM 管上下文结构与交付，MCP 管工具/数据接入），且按阶段限定工具定义可避免 Jones & Kelly 观察到的"预加载全部工具定义拖慢并抬升成本"问题。论文第 4 节报告了工作实现与早期实践者经验（内容在所给文本中被截断），第 6 节基于与多趟编译的结构类比，提出"语义调试"与"源级可追溯性"作为未来方向。
AI.conclusion: ICM 的核心主张是：对于顺序执行、每步需人工介入审核的工作流，"用文件系统替代框架编排"在可移植性、可检视性、可编辑性上更优，且能以构造方式（而非事后压缩）规避长上下文性能衰减；一个编排型智能体读取恰当文件即可完成多智能体框架的工作，等价于"one orchestrating agent + folder structure"。作者坦承这是"先退后进"（going backward before going forward）——直接复用 Unix 与编译器的成熟原则。其适用边界明确：不适用于需要动态多智能体协作、并发执行、复杂分支与内建重试/回退的场景，此时框架仍是更合适的选择。论文未提供严格的对照实验、用户研究或量化评测，现有证据主要是设计论证、token 计量示例与初步实践者报告，核心研究问题（文件层级结构对控制力、检视能力与输出质量的实际影响）仍需实证验证。此外需注意文本一致性问题：摘要中该方法被称作"Model Workspace Protocol (MWP)"，而正文与标题使用"Interpretable Context Methodology (ICM)"，代码仓库链接亦为 ICM 命名。

title: Data-Local Autonomous LLM-Guided Neural Architecture Search for Multiclass Multimodal Time-Series Classification
summary:
Applying machine learning to sensitive time-series data is often bottlenecked by the iteration loop: Performance depends strongly on preprocessing and architecture, yet training often has to run on-premise under strict data-local constraints. This is a common problem in healthcare and other privacy-constrained domains (e.g., a hospital developing deep learning models on patient EEG). This bottleneck is particularly challenging in multimodal fusion, where sensor modalities must be individually preprocessed and then combined. LLM-guided neural architecture search (NAS) can automate this exploration, but most existing workflows assume cloud execution or access to data-derived artifacts that cannot be exposed.
  We present a novel data-local, LLM-guided search framework that handles candidate pipelines remotely while executing all training and evaluation locally under a fixed protocol. The controller observes only trial-level summaries, such as pipeline descriptors, metrics, learning-curve statistics, and failure logs, without ever accessing raw samples or intermediate feature representations. Our framework targets multiclass, multimodal learning via one-vs-rest binary experts per class and modality, a lightweight fusion MLP, and joint search over expert architectures and modality-specific preprocessing.
  We evaluate our method on two regimes: UEA30 (public multivariate time-series classification dataset) and SleepEDFx sleep staging (heterogeneous clinical modalities such as EEG, EOG, and EMG). The results show that the modular baseline model is strong, and the LLM-guided NAS further improves it. Notably, our method finds models that perform within published ranges across most benchmark datasets. Across both settings, our method reduces manual intervention by enabling unattended architecture search while keeping sensitive data on-premise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数据本地化、LLM引导的神经架构搜索(NAS)框架，用于在严格隐私约束下（如医疗EEG数据）处理敏感时序数据的多模态融合。该框架在控制器仅访问试验级摘要而不接触原始数据的情况下，实现远程候选管道处理与本地训练评估的分离。
AI.motivation: 机器学习应用于敏感时序数据时面临迭代瓶颈：性能强烈依赖预处理和架构设计，但训练必须在严格的数据本地化约束下在本地执行。现有LLM引导的NAS工作流假设云端执行或可访问数据派生制品，这在隐私约束领域（如医疗EEG）不可行。多模态融合尤其具有挑战性，因为传感器模态需要单独预处理后组合。
AI.method: 提出一种数据本地化的LLM引导搜索框架：控制器仅观察试验级摘要（管道描述符、指标、学习曲线统计、失败日志），从不访问原始样本或中间特征表示。框架针对多类多模态学习，采用每类每模态的one-vs-rest二进制专家、轻量级融合MLP，并联合搜索专家架构和模态特定预处理。在UEA30（多变量时序分类）和SleepEDFx睡眠分期（EEG、EOG、EMG异构临床模态）上评估。
AI.result: 模块化基线模型表现强劲，LLM引导的NAS进一步提升性能。该方法在大多数基准数据集上达到已发表论文的性能范围内，同时减少人工干预，使敏感数据保持在本地实现无人值守的架构搜索。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的数据本地化LLM引导NAS框架能够有效解决隐私约束下的多模态时序学习问题，在保持数据隐私的同时实现架构搜索自动化，性能达到或接近已发表方法的水平。

title: Enhancing Linguistic Generalization of VLA: Fine-Tuning OpenVLA via Synthetic Instruction Augmentation
summary: Generalization remains a core challenge in embodied AI, as robots must adapt to diverse environments. While OpenVLA represents the State-of-the-Art (SOTA) in Vision-Language-Action models by leveraging large-scale pre-training, its zero-shot performance can be limited when encountering completely new environments. This paper proposes a parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategy to enhance the linguistic generalization of OpenVLA by synthesizing a general instruction set for the Bridge Dataset V2. The paper leverages a Large Language Model (LLM) to generate a rich variety of semantically equivalent but structurally diverse commands for existing trajectories. In this experiment, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is implemented to fine-tune OpenVLA on augmented pairs, allowing the model to bridge the gap between complex natural language intent and robotic actions. Results demonstrate that the LoRA-enhanced model's robustness, suggesting that enriching the linguistic space of specialized datasets is crucial for embodied agents.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes using LoRA fine-tuning with LLM-generated diverse instructions to enhance OpenVLA's linguistic generalization on the Bridge Dataset V2, demonstrating improved robustness in connecting natural language intent with robotic actions.
AI.motivation: Generalization remains a core challenge in embodied AI, as robots must adapt to diverse environments. While OpenVLA represents the State-of-the-Art in Vision-Language-Action models through large-scale pre-training, its zero-shot performance is limited when encountering completely new environments. There is a need to enhance the linguistic generalization of VLA models.
AI.method: The paper proposes a parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategy using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). It leverages a Large Language Model (LLG) to generate semantically equivalent but structurally diverse commands for existing trajectories in the Bridge Dataset V2. The augmented instruction-action pairs are then used to fine-tune OpenVLA, enabling the model to better generalize across diverse linguistic expressions.
AI.result: The LoRA-enhanced model demonstrates improved robustness in bridging the gap between complex natural language intent and robotic actions. The results suggest that enriching the linguistic space of specialized datasets is crucial for embodied agents.
AI.conclusion: enriching the linguistic space of specialized datasets with semantically equivalent but structurally diverse commands is crucial for improving embodied agents' generalization capabilities. The LoRA-enhanced model demonstrates improved robustness in bridging complex natural language intent with robotic actions.

title: MobileLLM-Flash: Latency-Guided On-Device LLM Design for Industry Scale
summary:
Real-time AI experiences call for on-device large language models (OD-LLMs) optimized for efficient deployment on resource-constrained hardware. The most useful OD-LLMs produce near-real-time responses and exhibit broad hardware compatibility, maximizing user reach. We present a methodology for designing such models using hardware-in-the-loop architecture search under mobile latency constraints. This system is amenable to industry-scale deployment: it generates models deployable without custom kernels and compatible with standard mobile runtimes like Executorch. Our methodology avoids specialized attention mechanisms and instead uses attention skipping for long-context acceleration.
  Our approach jointly optimizes model architecture (layers, dimensions) and attention pattern. To efficiently evaluate candidates, we treat each as a pruned version of a pretrained backbone with inherited weights, thereby achieving high accuracy with minimal continued pretraining. We leverage the low cost of latency evaluation in a staged process: learning an accurate latency model first, then searching for the Pareto-frontier across latency and quality.
  This yields MobileLLM-Flash, a family of foundation models (350M, 650M, 1.4B) for efficient on-device use with strong capabilities, supporting up to 8k context length. MobileLLM-Flash delivers up to 1.8x and 1.6x faster prefill and decode on mobile CPUs with comparable or superior quality. Our analysis of Pareto-frontier design choices offers actionable principles for OD-LLM design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种在移动延迟约束下进行硬件在环架构搜索的方法，设计出MobileLLM-Flash系列OD-LLMs（350M-1.4B参数），通过注意力跳过机制实现长上下文加速，在移动CPU上达到1.6-1.8倍的推理加速。
AI.motivation: 实时AI体验需要在资源受限硬件上高效部署的设备端大型语言模型(OD-LLMs)，而现有模型难以同时满足接近实时的响应速度和广泛的硬件兼容性需求。
AI.method: 采用硬件在环架构搜索方法，联合优化模型架构（层数、维度）和注意力模式。将每个候选模型视为预训练主干模型的剪枝版本以继承权重，通过两阶段过程（先学习精确延迟模型，再搜索延迟与质量的Pareto前沿）提高评估效率。使用注意力跳过机制替代专用注意力机制来实现长上下文加速。
AI.result: MobileLLM-Flash系列（350M、650M、1.4B参数）在移动CPU上实现了最高1.8倍的预填充加速和1.6倍的解码加速，同时保持相当或更优的质量，支持高达8k的上下文长度。
AI.conclusion: MobileLLM-Flash代表了在资源受限设备上部署LLM的重大进展，通过硬件驱动的架构搜索和注意力跳过机制，实现了在移动CPU上1.8倍预填充和1.6倍解码加速。该方法为OD-LLM设计提供了可操作的原则，并展示了无需自定义内核即可部署的可能性。

title: POaaS: Minimal-Edit Prompt Optimization as a Service to Lift Accuracy and Cut Hallucinations on On-Device sLLMs
comment: Accepted at FEVER 2026. 9 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables
summary: Small language models (sLLMs) are increasingly deployed on-device, where imperfect user prompts--typos, unclear intent, or missing context--can trigger factual errors and hallucinations. Existing automatic prompt optimization (APO) methods were designed for large cloud LLMs and rely on search that often produces long, structured instructions; when executed under an on-device constraint where the same small model must act as optimizer and solver, these pipelines can waste context and even hurt accuracy. We propose POaaS, a minimal-edit prompt optimization layer that routes each query to lightweight specialists (Cleaner, Paraphraser, Fact-Adder) and merges their outputs under strict drift and length constraints, with a conservative skip policy for well-formed prompts. Under a strict fixed-model setting with Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, POaaS improves both task accuracy and factuality while representative APO baselines degrade them, and POaaS recovers up to +7.4% under token deletion and mixup. Overall, per-query conservative optimization is a practical alternative to search-heavy APO for on-device sLLMs.

AI.tldr: POaaS是一种针对设备端小语言模型(sLLMs)的最小编辑提示优化框架，通过将查询路由到轻量级专业模块（Cleaner、Paraphraser、Fact-Adder）进行优化，并在严格的长度漂移约束下合并输出，对格式良好的提示采用保守跳过策略。在Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上，POaaS在任务准确性和事实性上均优于现有APO基线方法。
AI.motivation: 设备端部署的小语言模型(sLLMs)面临用户提示不完善的问题（拼写错误、意图不清、上下文缺失），这会导致事实性错误和幻觉。现有自动提示优化(APO)方法专为大型云端LLMs设计，采用搜索密集型策略产生冗长指令，在设备端约束下（同一个小模型同时担任优化器和求解器）会浪费上下文甚至降低准确性。
AI.method: 提出POaaS框架，包含三个轻量级专业模块：Cleaner（清理拼写错误）、Paraphraser（改写不清晰表达）、Fact-Adder（补充缺失上下文）。这些模块对每个查询进行路由处理，输出结果在严格的漂移和长度约束下合并，并对格式良好的提示采用保守的跳过策略以避免不必要的优化。
AI.result: 在严格的固定模型设置下（Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct），POaaS提升了任务准确性和事实性，而代表性APO基线方法反而降低了性能。POaaS在token删除和mixup场景下可恢复高达+7.4%的性能损失。
AI.conclusion: 对于设备端小语言模型，每查询保守优化是搜索密集型APO的实用替代方案。该方法通过最小化编辑和保守跳过策略，在有限计算资源下有效改善了sLLMs在处理不完善提示时的准确性和事实性。

title: GASP: Guided Asymmetric Self-Play For Coding LLMs
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 Workshop on AI with Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI 2026) as Spotlight, and ICLR 2026 Workshop on Lifelong Agents (LLA 2026)
summary: Asymmetric self-play has emerged as a promising paradigm for post-training large language models, where a teacher continually generates questions for a student to solve at the edge of the student's learnability. Although these methods promise open-ended data generation bootstrapped from no human data, they suffer from one major problem: not all problems that are hard to solve are interesting or informative to improve the overall capabilities of the model. Current asymmetric self-play methods are goal-agnostic with no real grounding. We propose Guided Asymmetric Self-Play (GASP), where grounding is provided by real-data goalpost questions that are identified to pose a hard exploration challenge to the model. During self-play, the teacher first generates an easier variant of a hard question, and then a harder variant of that easier question, with the goal of gradually closing the gap to the goalpost throughout training. Doing so, we improve pass@20 on LiveCodeBench (LCB) by 2.5% over unguided asymmetric self-play, and through the curriculum constructed by the teacher, we manage to solve hard goalpost questions that remain out of reach for all baselines.

AI.tldr: GASP通过引导式非对称自我Play方法，利用真实数据中的目标问题作为锚点，通过课程学习逐步提升模型能力，在LiveCodeBench上相比无引导的自我Play方法提升了2.5%的pass@20性能。
AI.motivation: 当前非对称自我Play方法虽然能从无人类数据引导的开放数据生成，但存在核心问题：并非所有难以解决的问题都是有趣或对提升模型能力有帮助的。这类方法缺乏真实的目标导向和根基。
AI.method: 提出GASP方法，以真实数据的困难目标问题作为引导。首先由教师生成困难问题的较简单变体，然后生成该简单问题的较难变体，通过课程学习逐步缩小与目标问题的差距。
AI.result: 在LiveCodeBench (LCB)上，pass@20相比无引导的非对称自我Play提升了2.5%，并成功解决了 baselines 无法触及的困难目标问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过将非对称自我Play与真实目标问题相结合，GASP能够更有效地引导模型学习，解决传统方法中缺乏有意义探索的问题，为大型语言模型的持续提升提供了新的训练范式。

title: A Context Alignment Pre-processor for Enhancing the Coherence of Human-LLM Dialog
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have made remarkable progress in generating fluent text, but they still face a critical challenge of contextual misalignment in long-term and dynamic dialogue. When human users omit premises, simplify references, or shift context abruptly during interactions with LLMs, the models may fail to capture their actual intentions, producing mechanical or off-topic responses that weaken the collaborative potential of dialogue. To address this problem, this paper proposes a computational framework called the Context Alignment Pre-processor (C.A.P.). Rather than operating during generation, C.A.P. functions as a pre-processing module between user input and response generation. The framework includes three core processes: (1) semantic expansion, which extends a user instruction to a broader semantic span including its premises, literal meaning, and implications; (2) time-weighted context retrieval, which prioritizes recent dialogue history through a temporal decay function approximating human conversational focus; and (3) alignment verification and decision branching, which evaluates whether the dialogue remains on track by measuring the semantic similarity between the current prompt and the weighted historical context. When a significant deviation is detected, C.A.P. initiates a structured clarification protocol to help users and the system recalibrate the conversation. This study presents the architecture and theoretical basis of C.A.P., drawing on cognitive science and Common Ground theory in human-computer interaction. We argue that C.A.P. is not only a technical refinement but also a step toward shifting human-computer dialogue from one-way command-execution patterns to two-way, self-correcting, partnership-based collaboration. Finally, we discuss implementation paths, evaluation methods, and implications for the future design of interactive intelligent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出C.A.P.（Context Alignment Pre-processor）框架，作为用户输入与响应生成之间的预处理模块，解决大型语言模型在长期动态对话中因上下文错位导致响应机械或离题的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM在生成流畅文本方面取得显著进展，但在长期和动态对话中面临关键挑战：当用户省略前提、简化引用或突然切换上下文时，模型可能无法捕捉其真实意图，产生机械或离题的回复，削弱对话的合作潜力。
AI.method: C.A.P.框架包含三个核心过程：（1）语义扩展，将用户指令扩展到更广泛的语义范围，包括前提、字面含义和隐含意义；（2）时间加权上下文检索，通过时间衰减函数优先考虑近期对话历史，模拟人类对话注意力；（3）对齐验证与决策分支，通过测量当前提示与加权历史上下文之间的语义相似度评估对话是否偏离轨道，检测到显著偏离时启动结构化澄清协议。
AI.result: 本文呈现了C.A.P.的架构和理论基础，借鉴认知科学和人机交互中的共同基础（Common Ground）理论。论证了C.A.P.不仅是一种技术改进，更是推动人机对话从单向命令执行模式转向双向、自我纠正的伙伴关系协作的步骤。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献包括：（1）提出解决上下文错位问题的创新预处理框架；（2）提供架构设计和理论基础；（3）讨论实现路径、评估方法及对未来交互智能系统设计的启示。

title: Deriving Hyperparameter Scaling Laws via Modern Optimization Theory
comment: v1: Preprint based on a short version published as a conference paper at SciForDL Workshop, 2nd edition
summary: Hyperparameter transfer has become an important component of modern large-scale training recipes. Existing methods, such as muP, primarily focus on transfer between model sizes, with transfer across batch sizes and training horizons often relying on empirical scaling rules informed by insights from timescale preservation, quadratic proxies, and continuous-time approximations. We study hyperparameter scaling laws for modern first-order optimizers through the lens of recent convergence bounds for methods based on the Linear Minimization Oracle (LMO), a framework that includes normalized SGD, signSGD (approximating Adam), and Muon. Treating bounds in recent literature as a proxy and minimizing them across different tuning regimes yields closed-form power-law schedules for learning rate, momentum, and batch size as functions of the iteration or token budget. Our analysis, holding model size fixed, recovers most insights and observations from the literature under a unified and principled perspective, with clear directions open for future research. Our results draw particular attention to the interaction between momentum and batch-size scaling, suggesting that optimal performance may be achieved with several scaling strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文把现代一阶优化器（归一化SGD、signSGD≈Adam、Muon）统一到线性最小化预言机（LMO）框架下，将 Kovalev 的非凸、非欧氏收敛上界当作"代理目标"，再对其关于学习率 η、动量（β=1−α）、批量 b 与 token 预算 T=bK 做最小化，从而在固定模型规模下导出一套闭式幂律超参缩放律：学习率、动量、批量随迭代数/token 预算的幂指数，并给出四类可操作的预算迁移规则。
AI.motivation: 超参迁移（hyperparameter transfer）已成为大规模训练配方的关键环节：μP 之类的方法只解决"模型规模之间"的学习率迁移，而在批量大小（batch size）与训练时长（training horizon）之间的迁移，仍主要依赖经验性缩放规则——二次近似、SDE 连续时间近似、时间尺度保持（timescale preservation）以及基于范数的直觉，这些规则彼此常相互矛盾且缺乏统一原理。同时，LMO 类一阶方法在动量的最坏情形收敛阶上与非凸 SGD 有本质差别（SGD 中动量只改进常数），现有理论工具未覆盖这类现代优化器的实际缩放行为。作者希望引入一个可解释、可解析求解的理论工具，统一解释文献中零散报告的经验规律（平方根学习率-批量关系、token 预算下的最优批量、次线性批量增长下的"临界批量"、动量随批量缩放等），并给出可落地的预算迁移规则。
AI.method: 方法为"上界即代理 + 超参最小化"。设 f 非凸、L-光滑，随机梯度噪声满足 E‖g_b−∇f‖² ≤ σ²/b，LMO 更新为 m^{k+1}=(1−α)m^k+α g_b^k，x^{k+1}=x^k+η·argmin_{‖d‖≤1}⟨m^{k+1},d⟩（取 ℓ₂ 得带动量归一化SGD，取 ℓ∞ 得 signSGD≈Adam，取谱范数得 Muon）。基于 Kovalev (Thm 2) 的非凸收敛界 min_k E‖∇f(x^k)‖_* ≤ Δ₀/(ηK) + 2ρσ/(α√b·K) + 2ρσ√(α/b) + 7Lη/2 + 2Lη/α，构造代理目标 risk_K(η,α,b)=C₁/(ηK) + (C₂/√b)(1+α^{3/2}K)/(αK) + C₃η(1+1/α)，并令 T=bK 得 risk_T。作者分三个调参情形对代理做解析最小化：(i) 固定动量（丢弃 burn-in 项，得大 horizon 简化式 C₁b/(ηT)+C̃₂/√b+C̃₃η）；(ii) 固定批量（保留领先项 C₁/(ηK)+C₂√(α/b)+C₃η/α，解 pα^{-1/2}+qα^{1/2} 型极小）；(iii) 三者联合（对 η 求极小得 s=√b 形式 As+B/s，对 α 求极小导出精确三次方程 (7/2)²Δ₀LT·α³ −(7/2)(ρσ)²α −2(ρσ)²=0，由其唯一正根定出 α∝T^{-1/3}）。全文以 T^{-1/4} 为目标，通过幂律假设 b(T)=Θ(T^β)、α(T)=Θ(T^{-γ})、η(T)=Θ(T^{-δ}) 给出五个衰减指数 r₁..r₅ 的通用分析，并做数值网格验证（η∈(10⁻¹⁵,10⁴)、b∈(1,10¹⁵)、α∈(10⁻¹⁰,1)、T∈(10²,10²²)，各取 100 个对数均匀采样点）。另用经典非凸 SGD 界做对照，并在附录 C 给出噪声模型/初始化/重尾/约束的敏感性分析。
AI.result: 【定理1，固定动量】迭代预算固定时 η*_K ∝ K^{-1/2}、risk ∝ K^{-1/2}+b^{-1/2}；token 预算固定时 η*_T(b) ∝ b^{1/2}T^{-1/2}，联合最优 b*_T ∝ T^{1/2}、η* ∝ T^{-1/4}、risk ∝ T^{-1/4}。该式统一解释了平方根学习率-批量缩放（b→κb 需 η→√κ η）与 token 预算缩放（η→κ^{-1/2}η），并给出非平凡的 token 最优批量（需联合调学习率），且该最优批量在超过动量相关的临界 token 数前为 b=1（与 SGD 形成鲜明对比：SGD 在同一分析下不存在非平凡 token 最优批量，且 η*∝bT^{-1/2} 呈线性批量缩放）。【定理2，固定批量】α*_T ∝ bT^{-1/2}、η*_T ∝ bT^{-3/4}、risk ∝ T^{-1/4}，与时间尺度保持/SDE 速度匹配结论一致。【定理3，联合调参】b*_T ∝ T^{1/6}、η*_T ∝ T^{-7/12}、α*_T ∝ T^{-1/3}、risk ∝ T^{-1/4}（α 由精确三次方程的根给出）。【推论1】动量重调最多只带来 2^{1/4}≈1.19 的常数增益（等价于至多 2× token 预算）；但若批量受硬件上限 b_max 约束，固定动量会残留 ∝√α/√b_max 的非消失噪声地板，而按 α∝bT^{-1/2} 缩放动量可消除该地板（Regime C 可支撑 T≲b_max²，Regime D 可支撑 T≲b_max⁶）。【推论2】若批量按 b(T)=T^φ 增长，φ≤1/2 时配合 α∝bT^{-1/2}、η∝bT^{-3/4} 仍可保 T^{-1/4}；φ∈(1/2,1) 时最好只能到 T^{-(1-φ)/2}（受迭代数限制）。【动量-批量耦合】β≈1−bT^{-1/2}，故 b→κb 对应 β→β^κ 的近似，与 Marek 等人关于 Adam β₂ 指数缩放的经验规则在 T→∞ 极限下一致。经验支持：160M 参数 PlainLM _transformer 在 SlimPajama 上 5B token 的恒定学习率网格搜索显示，固定批量下最优 η 随训练推进下降（b=32 时由 0.003 降至 0.001），且最优 η 随批量增大而增大（T=5B 时 b=32/128/512 对应 η=0.001/0.003/0.01），与理论一致。附录 C.3 给出"路径条件化"恒等式 q_eff = κp − λ(1−p)，解释了为何某些经验拟合会报告随 T 上升的最优学习率；同时指出指数不具普适性（依赖有限方差 b^{-1/2} 律、重尾/范数失配/参数约束等假设）。
AI.conclusion: 本文以现代优化理论（LMO 收敛界 + 上界最小化）为工具，在固定模型规模下系统导出了学习率、动量、批量随迭代数/token 预算的幂律缩放律，并给出四类预算迁移规则（A 固定 b 与 α：η∝(T₀/T₁)^{1/2}；B 固定 b、调 α：α∝(T₀/T₁)^{1/2}、η∝(T₀/T₁)^{3/4}；C 调 b 固定 α：b∝(T₁/T₀)^{1/2}、η∝(T₀/T₁)^{1/4}；D 全调：b∝(T₁/T₀)^{1/6}、α∝(T₀/T₁)^{1/3}、η∝(T₀/T₁)^{7/12}），并给出批量变化时的额外迁移表。作者强调该框架的价值在于统一解释经验规律、揭示动量与批量缩放的强耦合、以及指出"多条缩放路径近最优"的结论（T^{-1/4} 对应指数几乎唯一的 b* 指数只由低阶项选出）。局限与展望：分析依赖大 horizon 近似、常数学习率、匹配初始化、无权重衰减与 warmup/退火，未建模统计泛化（只假设总体目标的无偏梯度预言机），且固定模型规模未考虑 N、参数化（如 μP）的影响；未来需区分经验-理论差距究竟源于协议约束、假设失配还是收敛界的松弛，并扩展到学习率调度、权重衰减、warmup 与优化-泛化联合分析。

title: ARISE: Agent Reasoning with Intrinsic Skill Evolution in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
summary: The dominant paradigm for improving mathematical reasoning in language models relies on Reinforcement Learning with verifiable rewards. Yet existing methods treat each problem instance in isolation without leveraging the reusable strategies that emerge and accumulate during training. To this end, we introduce ARISE (Agent Reasoning via Intrinsic Skill Evolution), a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework, in which a shared policy operates both to manage skills at high-level and to generate responses at low-level (denoted as a Skills Manager and a Worker, respectively). The Manager maintains a tiered skill library through a dedicated skill generation rollout that performs structured summarization of successful solution traces (after execution), while employing a policy-driven selection mechanism to retrieve relevant skills to condition future rollouts (before execution). A hierarchical reward design guides the co-evolution of reasoning ability and library quality. Experiments on two base models and seven benchmarks spanning both competition mathematics and Omni-MATH show that ARISE consistently outperforms GRPO-family algorithms and memory-augmented baselines, with particularly notable gains on out-of-distribution tasks. Ablation studies confirm that each component contributes to the observed improvements and that library quality and reasoning performance improve in tandem throughout training. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Skylanding/ARISE}{https://github.com/Skylanding/ARISE}.

AI.tldr: ARISE 把「可复用数学解题技能库」作为智能体状态的一部分，用同一套共享策略同时充当高层技能管理器（Skills Manager）与低层解题者（Worker），在 RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）训练中实现策略与技能库的协同演化：策略用条件对数概率自行选择技能，梯度端到端回传；执行后再用一次额外的摘要 rollout 把成功轨迹蒸馏成结构化技能文档并入库，配合三级分层奖励（用到技能且答对=2，答对未用=1，答错=0）和两级 cache-reservoir 库管理。在 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 与 Phi-4-mini-instruct 上、基于 DeepScaleR 训练、在 AMC23/AIME24/AIME25 与 Omni-MATH 四个子域共 7 个基准上 consistently 优于 GRPO/Dr.GRPO/DAPO/GSPO 及 EvolveR、SimpleMem 等记忆/技能增强基线，Omni-MATH 平均提升 2.9 / 1.9 个点，且 token 开销仅 +3.0%（优于 EvolveR 的 +7.9%）。
AI.motivation: 现有 RLVR 数学推理方法（GRPO 家族）把每个问题实例孤立地求解，rollout 中产生的成功推理策略在轨迹结束后即被丢弃，无法沉淀为可复用资产。虽然 Reflexion/ExpeL/SimpleMem/EvolveR/SkillRL/SAGE 等工作已尝试引入外部记忆或技能结构，但仍存在两点根本局限：(1) 技能选择（执行前检索）与技能摘要（执行后归纳）交由外部检索器完成，策略梯度无法直接塑造技能选择偏好；(2) 技能库的更新独立于 RL 目标，割裂了策略改进与库丰富之间的反馈回路。作者的核心洞察是：技能库不应是静态外部资源，而应成为智能体状态的内生成分，与策略在训练全程协同演化。为此需解决三个挑战：库不是先验给定而须由智能体自建自炼、库状态与策略优化相互耦合、以及如何在 RL 目标下激励技能使用。
AI.method:
**形式化**：提出 Evolving-Skill MDP（ES-MDP）⟨Q, M, A, T, R⟩，增广状态 s_t=(q_t, M_t)，其中库状态 M_t 为内生成分；库条目 e_k=(m_k, u_k) 由技能文档与 EMA 维护的效用值组成；策略按三因子分解：π_mgr(z_t|q_t,M_t)·π_wkr(τ_t|q_t,m̃_{z_t})·π_lib(a_t^lib|q_t,M_t,τ_t)，三者共享参数 θ。

**Manager 端（选择）**：对每个候选技能用条件对数概率打分 s_k=Σ_l log π_θ(m_k^(l)|q_t, m_k^(<l))，经温度 σ 的 softmax 转为分布 p_k，再以 ε-贪心（(1-ε)·argmax+ε·Uniform）采样 z_t；置信门控 δ 要求 max_k p_k ≥ δ，否则取 no-skill 动作，不注入任何技能。选中的技能以 "SKILL:" 前缀拼接到 query 前注入 worker 上下文（无需结构改动）。

**Manager 端（生成与库管理）**：在 G 条解题 rollout 之外额外执行一次技能生成 rollout O_{G+1}，以原问题与正优势轨迹 τ^+={τ_i|Â_i>0}（最多 2 条，各截断 400 字符）为条件，把开放式策略归纳降级为结构化摘要；统一 JSON 模式（skill_name/problem_type/key_insight/method/check），总长硬上限 220 字符，使对数概率打分只反映语义相关性而非长度/格式偏差；生成结果经提取→解析→截断→插入四段校验，失败时回退到 trace_abstract。库为两级 cache-reservoir（容量 10 / 100），五个操作按固定顺序 Update→Add→Evict→Load→Delete 执行，Update 用 u←βu+(1-β)R（β=0.9），Evict 把低效用条目降级到 reservoir，Load 允许高效用 reservoir 条目回迁，Delete 永久删除效用低于 reservoir 第 10 百分位且零使用的条目。

**分层奖励**：R=r_task+r_skill∈{r0=0, r1=1, r2=2}；技能奖励仅在「使用技能且答对」时发放，答错一律 R=0，从而不鼓励注入无关技能。附录 B.3 给出该奖励下的组内优势结构：当组内 R=2 数量多于 R=0 时（μ_G>1），R=1 的「答对但未用技能」轨迹优势转为负值，即被主动降权。

**两阶段训练**：Phase I（N_w=500 步）用二元奖励标准 GRPO 热启动，同时每步执行 O_{G+1} 静默填充库（起始仅 5 个种子技能）；Phase II（第 501 步起）激活完整层级流水线，奖励切换为 R∈{0,1,2}，重要性采样比改为以技能条件化上下文计算。全程沿用 DAPO 式动态采样剔除零方差组。

**实现**：DeepScaleR 约 40K 样本、2000 步、8×A100-80GB、G=8、lr 1e-6（AdamW，wd 0.01，cosine + 50 步 warmup）、最大生成 4096  token、clip 0.2、有效批量 64；σ=1.0、ε=0.1、δ=0.35、打分截断 128 token、技能生成温度 0.7/top-p 0.95/192 token、r_skill=1.0。评估为 32 次独立贪心解码的平均 Pass@1，评测期 ε=0 关闭探索。

**附加分析工具**：定义信息增益 IG(m_k)（有/无条件化时正确轨迹的逐 token 对数概率差），并用「技能平均奖励/成功率与全局统计之差」的在线代理 Ĝ 追踪，每 100 步精确计算一次作为诊断（区分技能「因果贡献」与「与简单题目相关」的混淆）。
AI.result:
**主结果（Table 1）**：Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 上 ARISE 在全部 7 个基准领先——AMC23 75.4(+2.5)、AIME24 56.4(+2.3)、AIME25 48.3(+1.8)、Omni-MATH 四域 37.0/27.2/17.6/25.5，平均 26.8（较 GRPO 提升 2.9）；Phi-4-mini-instruct-3.8B 上同样全面领先，AMC23 45.3(+2.6)、AIME24 12.6(+2.3)、Omni-MATH 平均 11.4（+2.0）。优势在 OOD 上更明显，增益遍及四个子域且在 Algebra 提升最大（+3.5），说明演化库带来的是跨域迁移而非对训练分布的简单强化。EvolveR/SimpleMem 虽优于 GRPO，但不稳定超越 DAPO/GSPO，印证外部检索器与策略梯度脱钩的局限。

**消融（Table 2，Qwen3-4B）**：完整版 AIME24/25/Omni 为 56.4/49.1/28.0；退化为二元奖励下降最大（54.7/47.1/25.7），且技能利用率从 73% 跌至 31%，说明分层奖励是技能采纳的首要驱动；随机选技能保持高利用率但精度下降（55.1/47.8/26.3），表明不匹配技能是噪声源；去掉 O_{G+1} 则库冻结在 24 个种子技能，OOD 受损最重；去掉置信门控影响最小但利用率升至 91%，说明门控是边界情形的噪声过滤器。

**共演化动态（Figure 3）**：Phase II 激活后准确率与库规模同步上升并持续扩大差距；库规模在后期（约 step 1500）饱和而准确率继续提升，说明后期增益来自「更好地选择已有技能」而非继续扩充库。技能演化呈「泛化启发式 → 领域专用技巧」的轨迹（Vieta 根重构、圆内接角追角等）。

**超参敏感性（Table 7）**：δ=0.35 最佳（技能使用率 73.0%），δ=0.15 降至 55.2、δ=0.55 降至 55.0；ε∈[0.05,0.15] 稳健，ε=0（55.7）与 ε=0.3（54.9）均更差；cache 容量 10 最优（5/20/50 分别 55.5/56.1/55.3）；warm-up 500 最优（200→54.8，1000→55.5）。

**效率（Table 9/10）**：AIME24 上每题平均 token 开销仅 +3.0%（+66 prompt token），优于 EvolveR 的 +7.9%（后者 Omni-MATH 仅 +0.7）；响应长度与 GRPO 相当（2876 vs 2847），说明技能注入不诱导冗长输出。单步耗时 59.7s vs GRPO 51.2s（+16.6%），其中技能生成 4.8s、评分选择 2.4s、库维护 0.1s。
AI.conclusion: ARISE 通过统一的 Manager-Worker 共享策略把技能选择、技能生成与策略优化整合到同一 RL 目标下，使技能库成为智能体的内生状态并与策略全程协同演化；形式化为 Evolving-Skill MDP，配合策略驱动的条件对数概率选技、三级分层奖励与两级 cache-reservoir 库管理，构成「策略改进—库丰富」的正反馈回路。实验证明其在两个基座、7 个基准上稳定超越 GRPO 家族与记忆/技能增强基线，OOD（Omni-MATH）增益尤为突出；消融表明分层奖励是技能采纳的主要驱动力，而后期收益来自对既有技能的更优选择，即技能「策展」比「数量」更重要。局限与未来方向：目前仅在数学推理上验证；技能以推理启发式而非可执行过程形式存在，需扩展到多工具智能体与代码生成；技能评分与生成带来约 16.6% 的步时开销，可通过批处理打分或缓存未变技能的 log 概率进一步压缩；IG 代理等诊断工具提示未来可设计更具选择性的库管理策略（如识别「高效用但低因果贡献」的技能）。

title: Determinism in the Undetermined: Deterministic Output in Charge-Conserving Continuous-Time Neuromorphic Systems with Temporal Stochasticity
summary: Achieving deterministic computation results in asynchronous neuromorphic systems remains a fundamental challenge due to the inherent temporal stochasticity of continuous-time hardware. To address this, we develop a unified continuous-time framework for spiking neural networks (SNNs) that couples the Law of Charge Conservation with minimal neuron-level constraints. This integration ensures that the terminal state depends solely on the aggregate input charge, providing a unique cumulated output invariant to temporal stochasticity. We prove that this mapping is strictly invariant to spike timing in acyclic networks, whereas recurrent connectivity can introduce temporal sensitivity. Furthermore, we establish an exact representational correspondence between these charge-conserving SNNs and quantized artificial neural networks, bridging the gap between static deep learning and event-driven dynamics without approximation errors. These results establish a rigorous theoretical basis for designing continuous-time neuromorphic systems that harness the efficiency of asynchronous processing while maintaining algorithmic determinism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套"电荷守恒（LoCC）+ 最小神经元级约束"的统一连续时间 SNN 框架，证明在无环拓扑下，脉冲发放时刻、传播延迟、抖动等时间随机性不会影响终端输出：终端解码结果仅由注入的总电荷决定（κ* = (σ∘𝒟)(u+Wκ*)），并进一步证明这类 SNN 与量化人工神经网络（QANN）之间存在精确（无近似误差）的双向表示对应。
AI.motivation: 异步神经形态硬件在连续时间下存在固有的时间随机性（异步输入投递、抖动、非均匀传播延迟），同一计算会以不同脉冲序列展开，可能改变终端结果；而标准脉冲神经元模型（LIF/EIF 等）的终端输出依赖路径相关的瞬态电压动力学与特定重置规则，缺乏模型无关的确定性判据。作者因此提出核心问题：如何在"时间未确定"的物理基底上保证算法层面的确定性（algorithmic determinism）。答案是把设计范式从"状态依赖动力学"转向"守恒式记账（conservation-based bookkeeping）"，将 LoCC 作为算法约束而非孤立物理事实。
AI.method: 1) 单神经元模型：C V̇(t) = I_in(t) − Q̇(t)，Q̇ 为脉冲触发的原子测度放电；引入两个神经元级设计条件——(i) 静默集解码结构：{Ω_Q = Q + C·V*(Q)} 构成 ℝ 的互不相交覆盖分割，从而唯一确定解码映射 𝒟: ℝ→𝒬；(ii) 严格向静默推进：每次脉冲后到静默集的距离 Φ 以固定步长 δ 递减（或直接进入静默集），保证有限脉冲终止。输出由激活映射 σ 再编码：Q_out(t)=σ(Q(t))。2) 网络耦合：仅通过脉冲级输出电荷交互，突触核 k_ij 有限支撑且电荷归一化 ∫k=1，延迟 τ_ij 可随机，故总传输电荷与时间形态无关；外部输入 episode 以聚合电荷 u 参数化。3) 理论证明：引理4.1（LoCC 记账恒等式）、4.2（静默态放电水平唯一性）、4.3（严格推进→有限脉冲）、定理4.4（单神经元终端输出 = (σ∘𝒟)(总注入电荷)，与时间实现无关）；定理4.5（无环网络存在唯一时序不变终端输出，满足分量不动点方程）；附录给出完整测度化技术约定与证明。4) 具体实现（§5.1）：广义 ST-BIF 神经元，放电水平集合 𝒬 为有限有序集，脉冲仅作为在相邻水平间跳转的事件机制（阈值 V_thr(q)=(succ(q)−q)/C，向上/向下脉冲），并验证其满足解码分区 Ω_q=[q,succ(q)) 与 Lyapunov 函数 Φ 的严格递减。5) 对应性：定理5.2（SNN→QANN）与定理5.4（QANN→SNN，激活为 σ∘𝒟 形式且分段常值），均为精确对应。
AI.result: 主要结果：(a) 建立了模型无关的连续时间 LoCC 形式与最小神经元级约束；(b) 无环拓扑下 SNN 终端输出严格时序不变，仅由聚合注入电荷决定，可沿拓扑序逐层求值；(c) 与 QANN 的精确双向表示对应，无需速率平均或近似误差；(d) 无环性是尖锐结构边界——含环网络即使满足同样神经元条件也可能出现多不动点、2-周期与"可达性缺口"（例4.8、附录E 的正/负自环反例）；(e) 重要负面结论（Remark 4.7）：即使单神经元，脉冲数与终止时间也不存在仅依赖聚合电荷的统一上界，故仅依赖网络深度等粗粒度参数的收敛时间界一般不成立。
AI.conclusion: LoCC 与最小神经元级约束（唯一解码结构 + 严格向静默推进）结合无环连接，可在连续时间异步神经形态硬件中把时间随机性"过滤"为仅影响瞬态轨迹、不影响终端解码结果，从而把 SNN 确立为静态量化算法的精确、节能的动态实现，而非其带噪近似。局限：保证仅限于无环拓扑与分段常值（量化）激活；一般激活函数仅可通过细化 𝒬 逼近而无保证；一般激活的反向实现超出本文范围。未来工作：电荷守恒递归网络的稳定性分析，以及用守恒约束指导生物可学习的算法。

title: VIGIL: Towards Edge-Extended Agentic AI for Enterprise IT Support
summary: Enterprise IT support is constrained by heterogeneous devices, evolving policies, and long-tail failure modes that are difficult to resolve centrally. We present VIGIL, an edge-extended agentic AI system that deploys desktop-resident agents to perform situated diagnosis, retrieval over enterprise knowledge, and policy-governed remediation directly on user devices with explicit consent and end-to-end observability. In a 10-week pilot of VIGIL's operational loop on 100 resource-constrained endpoints, VIGIL reduces interaction rounds by 39%, achieves at least 4 times faster diagnosis, and supports self-service resolution in 82% of matched cases. Users report excellent usability, high trust, and low cognitive workload across four validated instruments, with qualitative feedback highlighting transparency as critical for trust. Notably, users rated the system higher when no historical matches were available, suggesting on-device diagnosis provides value independent of knowledge base coverage. This pilot establishes safety and observability foundations for fleet-wide continuous improvement.

AI.tldr: VIGIL 是一种“边缘扩展（edge-extended）”的智能体 AI 架构：把诊断与修复能力下沉到用户桌面端代理，在云端协调与治理下执行情境化诊断、企业知识检索与受策略约束的自动修复，并强调显式用户同意与端到端可观测性。10 周真实试点（100 台资源受限 Windows 终端）显示：交互轮次降低 39%，诊断速度至少快 4 倍，82% 的匹配案例可自助闭环；SUS 86.2、信任 4.29/5、TAM 4.41/5、NASA-TLX 2.53/7（低认知负荷）。关键发现是：在无历史相似案例时用户评分反而更高，说明本地诊断价值不依赖知识库覆盖。
AI.motivation: 大型企业 IT 环境由异构设备、网络与策略构成，且处于部分可观测状态，失败往往源于微妙的本地交互而非全局故障，导致诊断被动且缓慢；运维知识分散，支持流程仍依赖中心化人工干预与静态剧本。同时，AI 智能体已具备通过终端接口执行操作的“computer-use”能力，但企业平台目前多在预定义自动化边界内做中心化编排，缺少分布式端侧执行。既有边缘 AI 研究停留在理论层面，未解决治理、可观测性与安全约束；而在端侧直接执行有界动作可带来更低延迟、更细粒度本地上下文与弱连接下的韧性，但分布式自主必须配合防止越界的机制。
AI.method: 提出双环架构：（1）运行环——端侧执行“诊断→检索→修复”流程，由 Planner、Diagnosis、Knowledge、Remediation 四个本地智能体经 MCP 工具接口共享状态；（2）自改进环——以结构化经验信号精炼记忆、检索策略、提示词与治理策略，不做模型重训练，列为未来工作。工程实现为基于 AWS Strands + Bedrock（Claude Opus 4.1）的桌面应用（PyInstaller 打包），采用 A2A 协议、OpenTelemetry 追踪、OPA 策略引擎、企业 SSO。所有状态变更经本地确定性策略引擎判定为 allow/warn/deny 三级：低风险自动执行，中风险需自然语言说明并获得显式同意，高风险直接阻断；修复按步执行并逐步验证，健康信号恶化时调整计划或升级，优先选择可回滚动作。评估采用 PoV 试点：10 周、100 台 Windows HP G8 端点；与含 6 万余条历史工单的集中式图谱仓库（CGR）做回溯案例匹配（稠密向量相似度阈值 0.55 + LLM 全案核验置信度≥7/10），比较交互轮次、诊断时长、五维响应质量（LLM-as-judge）与自助解决潜力；并用 SUS、NASA-TLX、Trust in Automation、TAM 四个成熟量表做用户体验评估。
AI.result: 153 次会话中 60 次（39%）成功匹配历史案例。效率：VIGIL 中位 11 个自主推理周期 vs 人工 18 轮对话，交互轮次降低 39%（60 对中 50 对达成）；中位诊断耗时 36.5 秒，按人工中位 26.5 分钟中仅 10% 为实际作业时间的保守估计，速度至少快 4 倍（现实估计 4–17 倍）。质量：五维自动评分（问题理解 8.5、相关性 8.1、可执行性 7.8、完整性 7.4、根因准确性 7.1）中位总分 8.0/10，81% 会话被评为 Good/Excellent；自助解决潜力 82%（高置信 39% + 中置信 43%）；根因准确性最弱，为改进方向。可靠性：95.4% 会话调用诊断工具，1,586 次调用工具成功率 95.3%。UX（n=23）：SUS 86.2±15.7（高于行业均值 68，落在 Excellent 档、约第 90 百分位）、Trust 4.29/5、TAM 4.41/5、NASA-TLX 2.53/7（低负荷）。分层分析显示 16 位“无历史匹配”用户评分更高（SUS 89.2、Trust 4.44、TAM 4.55、TLX 2.29）。定性反馈（n=8）三点：透明性是信任关键；用户希望获得更高权限以自主完成任务；希望扩大推广范围。附录给出无故障、失败（需升级至人工/换硬件）、成功（睡眠唤醒故障，11 条命令、成功率 90.9%、逐步验证）三类执行示例，以及 OPA 的 allow/warn/deny 策略示例与 LLM 评判提示词。
AI.conclusion: 将推理与执行动作下沉到故障发生的环境（端侧），可在降低延迟、保留细粒度上下文的同时实现弱连接下的韧性运行；配合确定性策略控制下的分布式自主，是在企业 IT 运维中实现可扩展、可治理自治的可行架构方向。试点也奠定了安全与可观测性基础，可支撑后续全量机队持续改进。局限：案例匹配仅覆盖 39% 会话（未匹配案例可能系统性更复杂）；响应质量由 LLM 自动评估而非人类专家判定；问卷回收率仅 23/100，存在自选择偏差；试点仅覆盖单一设备类别，向异构机队的泛化性待验证；自改进环（上下文与提示词优化）在本次部署中未被启用。伦理方面：100 名参与者均签署知情同意，交互轨迹分析前已匿名化，中风险操作需显式用户批准、高风险无条件阻断，全部推理与动作可审计。

title: W2T: LoRA Weights Already Know What They Can Do
summary: Each LoRA checkpoint compactly stores task-specific updates in low-rank weight matrices, offering an efficient way to adapt large language models to new tasks and domains. In principle, these weights already encode what the adapter does and how well it performs. In this paper, we ask whether this information can be read directly from the weights, without running the base model or accessing training data. A key obstacle is that a single LoRA update can be factorized in infinitely many ways. Without resolving this ambiguity, models trained on the factors may fit the particular factorization rather than the underlying update. To this end, we propose \methodfull, which maps each LoRA update to a provably canonical form via QR decomposition followed by SVD, so that all equivalent factorizations share the same representation. The resulting components are then tokenized and processed by a Transformer to produce a weight-space embedding. Across language and vision LoRA collections, W2T achieves strong results on attribute classification, performance prediction, and adapter retrieval, demonstrating that LoRA weights reliably indicate model behavior once factorization ambiguity is removed. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaolonghan2000/Weight2Token.

AI.tldr: 本文提出W2T方法，通过QR分解和SVD将LoRA更新映射到规范形式，解决因子分解歧义问题，从而从LoRA权重中直接提取模型行为信息。
AI.motivation: LoRA检查点紧凑存储了任务特定更新，理论上已包含适配器的功能信息，但关键障碍是单个LoRA更新可以无限多种方式分解，导致模型可能拟合特定分解而非底层更新。
AI.method: 提出W2T方法，通过QR分解后接SVD将每个LoRA更新映射到可证明的规范形式，使所有等价因子分解共享相同表示，然后将结果组件进行标记化并由Transformer处理生成权重空间嵌入。
AI.result: 在语言和视觉LoRA集合上，W2T在属性分类、性能预测和适配器检索任务上取得强劲结果，证明一旦消除因子分解歧义，LoRA权重可可靠指示模型行为。
AI.conclusion: 通过消除因子分解歧义，可以从LoRA权重直接读取模型行为信息，为理解和分析微调模型提供了新途径。

title: NeuronSpark: A Spiking Neural Network Language Model with Selective State Space Dynamics
summary: We ask whether a pure spiking backbone can learn large-scale language modeling from random initialization, without Transformer distillation. We introduce NeuronSpark, a 0.9B-parameter SNN language model trained with next-token prediction and surrogate gradients. The model combines selective state-space spiking dynamics, leakage-current inter-layer communication, PonderNet adaptive timesteps, fused Triton PLIF kernels, and stabilization techniques (residual centering, lateral-inhibition normalization, and natural-gradient compensation). Under a constrained budget (about 1.4B pretraining tokens and 6.5K SFT steps), NeuronSpark-0.9B reaches 3.6 pretraining loss and shows early multi-turn dialogue behavior after SFT. These results support the feasibility of end-to-end language modeling with a pure SNN architecture at this scale.

AI.tldr: NeuronSpark 构建了一个纯脉冲、自注意力自由的十亿参数语言模型：其核心创新是 SelectivePLIF——把 PLIF 神经元的膜衰减率 β_t、输入增益 α_t 与发放阈值 V_th(t) 全部改为 token 内容依赖的函数，从而直接化解"发放率刚性"引发的密集发放/静默训练崩溃；再配合 PLIF 门控的线性注意力式联想记忆、PonderNet 式自适应时间聚合与残差中心化/侧抑制归一化/自然梯度补偿等稳定化手段，在 2.1B token、随机初始化、无任何蒸馏或骨干迁移的条件下取得 40.0 的八任务零样本均值，并在 VHDL 仿真与 FPGA 实板上给出操作能耗代理与 TTFT/TPS 优势。
AI.motivation: 论文关注的核心问题是：纯脉冲（spiking）骨干能否不依赖 Transformer 蒸馏/转换/骨干迁移，直接从随机初始化做大规模语言建模。作者指出既有脉冲语言模型（SpikeGPT、SpikeBERT/SpikeLM、SpikingMamba、SpikingSSMs）普遍采用固定参数神经元，选择性要么来自外部架构（RWKV 递归、Mamba 转移矩阵、Transformer 注意力），要么需预先训练一个代理动态网络绕过 LIF 迭代。作者进一步诊断出一个神经元层面的结构性障碍——"发放率刚性（firing-regime rigidity）"：标准脉冲神经元对每个 token 使用同一发放敏感度与全局可学习阈值，而语言序列中名词、标点、虚词的信息角色差异巨大，导致同一层同一时刻要么全员密集发放（表征塌缩为常数信号），要么几乎静默（代理梯度消失），仅靠全局参数调节无法兼顾。该诊断被形式化为层发放率 ρ_{ℓ,s}→1（饱和）与 ρ_{ℓ,s}→0（静默）两种经验上稳定的失败吸引子，且 LTI 递推缺少内容依赖的转移（Gu & Dao, 2023），这正是选择性状态空间模型的关键表达能力来源。
AI.method: 架构为自注意力自由的三段式管线：token 嵌入沿时间轴复制 K=12 帧成 (S·K,B,D) 张量，经 24 层混合 SNN 层（18 层 SNN decoder + 每 4 层插入 1 层联想记忆层），再聚合回 (S,B,D) 并投影为词表 logits。核心是 SelectivePLIF 神经元：β_t=sigmoid(W_β h_t+b_β)、α_t=softplus(W_α h_t+b_α)、V_th(t)=V_min+|W_th h_t+b_th|，软复位保留超阈信息（Assumption 1），并可退化为标准 PLIF 与标量 LTI SSM（Proposition 1，含严格包含关系证明）。SNNBlock 用选择性递推 + 门控连续读出 o_t=W_out V_post ⊙ sigmoid(W_g x_t)+W_sk x_t；spiking FFN 用两路固定 PLIF 的泄漏激活充当 gate/up 分支；每 token 的 K 帧用 PonderNet 几何权重 λ_{s,k}=p_{s,k}∏_{j<k}(1-p_{j}) 做可微时间聚合，并以 ponder 损失（λ_p=0.01）正则化晚期质量。联想记忆层把固定 PLIF 的泄漏激活转成标量写门 g_t，M_T=Σ g_t k_t v_t^⊤，当 g_t≡1 时退化为线性注意力的累积外积记忆（Remark 1）。稳定化手段包括：残差中心化（减去特征均值）、输出端 DI（除性归一化/侧抑制）连续健康控制路径、以及两阶段自然梯度补偿（对 b_β、b_α 做 sigmoid/softplus 局部导数补偿，再按层做几何均值裁剪重缩放）。训练：BF16、AdamW（lr 3e-4 余弦降至 3e-5，warmup 1000，wd 0.1，clip 1.0）、批量 512 序列（1M token/step）、上下文 2048、8×H100 约 14 天、seed 42、数据为 Common Crawl 60%/Gutenberg 25%/GitHub 10%/Wikipedia 5%，lm-evaluation-harness 零样本评测。推理侧用融合 Triton PLIF kernel（K 步顺序扫描、batch×width 并行、反向用 V_pre=V_post+V_th·s 重构 + α_sg=4.0 sigmoid 代理梯度）；硬件侧另做参数对齐的 1.260B 词汇表对齐派生模型，编写 VHDL 数据通路（层级零/瓦片门控、折叠乘积页缓存），并在 ALINX VD100（AMD Versal VE2302）上做物理时延测量。
AI.result: 基准（lm-eval 零样本，acc_norm/acc 混合）：NeuronSpark-1.1B（1.16B 参数、2.1B token）八任务均值 40.0（ARC-E 0.462、ARC-C 0.247、WinoGrande 0.511、BoolQ 0.601、PIQA 0.604、OBQA 0.284、MMLU 0.232、C-Eval 0.262），高于同预算 Pythia-1B step1000（33.2）与 Mamba-1.6B pre-1000（33.7，尽管其用 3.67B token），达到 300B token 充分训练 Pythia-1B（42.0）的 95.2% 与 Mamba-1.6B（42.9）的 93.2%；BoolQ 0.601 接近 Pythia 0.607，MMLU 与 Pythia 同为 0.232，C-Eval 0.262 为列表基线最高。WT2 困惑度 9.70；相较 SNN 参照（SpikeGPT 216M、SpikingLLM-CSSA T=2/4）多项下游更优。token 效率：Pts/B 0.191 vs Pythia 0.158、Mamba 0.092。训练轨迹 loss 由 11.24 降至约 3.5（可用 trace 止于 479K 步）。消融（短程 4090 FSDP 拒绝性诊断）：移除输入依赖 PLIF、去掉 phase-2 梯度补偿、Sinkhorn 健康度、Cortical lateral、HC-α 解耦等变体均停在 7–8 loss 带并反转，未能进入低 loss 稳态。时间动力学：64 条 TinyStories 提示上内容词/子词片段的软帧中心更晚（5.80、5.73 vs 冠词 3.84、介词连词 4.41、标点 4.71），β(t) 跨 token 与 SNNBlock 分布 0.42–0.91；SNNBlock 层均时间尺度随深度从约 3.5 增至 7.8 帧，末层 β 均值与深度 Pearson r=0.86，最深层 β≈0.87–0.88，而联想记忆门保持 β≈0.50 且离散更大，自发形成快–慢层级；输出 PLIF 轨迹在 168 帧内含 51 次发放，证明多帧计算是膜状态积分而非重复前馈。硬件（2048 token、参数对齐 1.26B、VHDL 位精确）：能量点操作能耗代理 0.273821e12 vs Transformer 2.768430e12（−90.1%）与 Mamba 0.829721e12（−67.0%）；速度点周期 2,496,512 vs Transformer 42,242,890（−94.1%）与 Mamba 12,660,736（−80.3%）。FPGA 实板（BF16、2 token 提示、4 token 生成）：TTFT 24.000 s、解码 0.082440 TPS，相比 Cortex-A72 上的 Transformer（73.509 s / 0.024262 TPS）与 Mamba（70.683 s / 0.024125 TPS）提速 3.063×/2.945×，TPS 提升 3.398×/3.417×，A/B 最大离散 0.337%。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张：把选择性放到神经元本身（逐 token 的阈值、衰减与增益）而非外部架构或预训练骨干，可以解除脉冲 LM 的发放吸引子问题，使十亿规模端到端预训练变得可行——NeuronSpark-1.1B 是其所述首个无骨干迁移、无转换、无蒸馏的原生十亿参数脉冲 LM，确立了"可训练的十亿规模脉冲基座 + 可实现的低代价硬件路径"的可行性结论。作者明确标注的边界与局限包括：单一种子、非数据受控（data-controlled）的架构对比（仅控制参数规模、token 预算、检查点来源、评测协议等可审计维度；完全对齐需额外数千 H100 GPU-小时）、VHDL 能耗仅为操作代理而非实测焦耳、FPGA 结论限于单板、单向、极短上下文的实现层时延比较（NeuronSpark 用 Arm/PL 混合路径而基线用 Cortex-A72，非同等算力资源）、K=12 帧与 PLIF 门控累积记忆的充分性均为显式假设、2.1B token 预算源于租用算力到期而非训练饱和，且能量/速度各为一个独立接受工作点。需注意摘要与正文存在口径差异（摘要称 0.9B 参数、约 1.4B token、3.6 预训练损失与 6.5K SFT 步多轮对话，正文报告 1.16B 参数、2.1B token、40.0 零样本均值，未详述 SFT 对话实验），且部分基线（SpikingLLM-CSSA）无公开检查点，其分数由 OPT-1.3B 复现值按论文相对比值折算得到，比较结论应据此谨慎解读。

title: The Importance of Being Smoothly Calibrated
summary:
Recent work has highlighted the centrality of smooth calibration [Kakade and Foster, 2008] as a robust measure of calibration error. We generalize, unify, and extend previous results on smooth calibration, both as a robust calibration measure, and as a step towards omniprediction, which enables predictions with low regret for downstream decision makers seeking to optimize some proper loss unknown to the predictor.
  We present a new omniprediction guarantee for smoothly calibrated predictors, for the class of all bounded proper losses. We smooth the predictor by adding some noise to it, and compete against smoothed versions of any benchmark predictor on the space, where we add some noise to the predictor and then post-process it arbitrarily. The omniprediction error is bounded by the smooth calibration error of the predictor and the earth mover's distance from the benchmark. We exhibit instances showing that this dependence cannot, in general, be improved. We show how this unifies and extends prior results [Foster and Vohra, 1998; Hartline, Wu, and Yang, 2025] on omniprediction from smooth calibration.
  We present a crisp new characterization of smooth calibration in terms of the earth mover's distance to the closest perfectly calibrated joint distribution of predictions and labels. This also yields a simpler proof of the relation to the lower distance to calibration from [Blasiok, Gopalan, Hu, and Nakkiran, 2023].
  We use this to show that the upper distance to calibration cannot be estimated within a quadratic factor with sample complexity independent of the support size of the predictions. This is in contrast to the distance to calibration, where the corresponding problem was known to be information-theoretically impossible: no finite number of samples suffice [Blasiok, Gopalan, Hu, and Nakkiran, 2023].

AI.tldr: 本文研究平滑校准与全预测的统一理论，提出新的全预测保证和平滑校准的地球移动距离刻画，证明了上校准距离估计的二次因子下界，统一扩展了平滑校准和全预测领域的先前结果。
AI.motivation: 平滑校准是校准误差的鲁棒度量，但现有研究缺乏统一理论；全预测（omniprediction）能使预测器在下游决策者优化任意正确损失时实现低遗憾，但此前研究未建立与平滑校准的完整联系；需要理解校准度量的计算复杂性和估计极限。
AI.method: 通过向预测器添加噪声并进行后处理的方式实现平滑；利用地球移动距离（Earth Mover's Distance）作为度量工具；采用分布分析和信息论方法证明下界。
AI.result: 提出了一种针对所有有界正确损失的全预测保证，平滑预测器的全预测误差以预测器的平滑校准误差和基准的地球移动距离为界；给出了平滑校准的新刻画，证明了到校准的上距离估计问题无法在样本复杂度与预测支持大小无关的情况下达到小于二次因子的近似比。
AI.conclusion: 该工作统一并扩展了平滑校准和全预测的相关结果，证明了到校准的上距离无法在样本复杂度与预测支持大小无关的情况下以小于二次因子被估计，揭示了平滑校准与地球移动距离之间的深刻联系。

title: SQL-ASTRA: Alleviating Sparse Feedback in Agentic SQL via Column-Set Matching and Trajectory Aggregation
summary: Agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) shows promise for complex tasks, but Text-to-SQL remains mostly restricted to single-turn paradigms. A primary bottleneck is the credit assignment problem. In traditional paradigms, rewards are determined solely by the final-turn feedback, which ignores the intermediate process and leads to ambiguous credit evaluation. To address this, we propose Agentic SQL, a framework featuring a universal two-tiered reward mechanism designed to provide effective trajectory-level evaluation and dense step-level signals. First, we introduce Aggregated Trajectory Reward (ATR) to resolve multi-turn credit assignment. Using an asymmetric transition matrix, ATR aggregates process-oriented scores to incentivize continuous improvement. Leveraging Lyapunov stability theory, we prove ATR acts as an energy dissipation operator, guaranteeing a cycle-free policy and monotonic convergence. Second, Column-Set Matching Reward (CSMR) provides immediate step-level rewards to mitigate sparsity. By executing queries at each turn, CSMR converts binary (0/1) feedback into dense [0, 1] signals based on partial correctness. Evaluations on BIRD show a 5% gain over binary-reward GRPO. Notably, our approach outperforms SOTA Arctic-Text2SQL-R1-7B on BIRD and Spider 2.0 using identical models, propelling Text-to-SQL toward a robust multi-turn agent paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Agentic SQL（SQL-ASTRA）框架，把 Text-to-SQL 从单轮 RL 范式扩展为多轮智能体交互，并设计了通用的"两层奖励机制"：列集合匹配奖励（CSMR）提供稠密的步骤级部分正确性信号，聚合轨迹奖励（ATR）用非对称转移矩阵在轨迹级汇总步级奖励，并以李雅普诺夫稳定性理论证明其具备能量耗散性质、可消除极限环。
AI.motivation: Text-to-SQL 领域的强化学习仍局限于单轮、静态生成，无法模拟数据分析师通过多次试探性查询迭代修正 SQL 的真实过程；在多轮轨迹中奖励通常只来自最终轮反馈（all-or-nothing），导致严重的信用分配问题，智能体无法区分哪些中间步骤对最终结果有贡献；即便有步骤级反馈，通常也只是基于执行成功的粗糙 0/1 二值信号，忽略了"部分正确"查询中的丰富信息，导致奖励稀疏、微观层面引导不足，显著限制 RL 训练的效率与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1) 多轮交互框架：将交互式 Text-to-SQL 形式化为有限时域 MDP M=⟨S,A,P,R⟩，动作空间为 execute_sql(query) 与 finish(answer) 工具调用，转移中嵌入 Rethink 机制（依据数据库返回结果自主判断继续迭代或终止），状态包含问题、schema 与历史观测，智能体从零开始 RL 训练。2) CSMR（列集合匹配奖励）：每轮执行查询后不比较行元组，而是比较各列的唯一值集合；先做完美匹配检查（返回 1.0），否则对去重后的金标/预测结果提取列值集合 D_G、D_P，统计匹配列数 M，得 R = M²/(N_c^G × N_c^P) × α（α=0.8），将 0/1 稀疏反馈转为 [0,1] 稠密信号；α<1 用于区分"伪完美"（列集合相同但行组合不同）与真正完美匹配。3) ATR（聚合轨迹奖励）：仅在 episode 终止时给出一个标量奖励，由非对称转移矩阵 M = [[−0.0, +1.0], [−1.5, 0.0]] 构成 Ψ(R_{t−1},R_t)，以 |ΔR_t| 缩放，状态由 ΔR_t 符号与停滞阈值 τ=0.6 判定（Low→High 记 +1.0，High→Low 记 −1.5，同状态记 0），实现 |R_High→Low| > |R_Low→High| 的严格耗散性；理论上以 V(s)=1−Φ(s)（Φ=CSMR 分数）为李雅普诺夫候选函数，证明对称奖励仅 Lagrange 稳定且允许极限环（ΣR_t=0），而 ATR 保证任意非平凡闭环 ΣR_t<0，从而消除极限环、保证单调收敛；τ 还起类似滑模控制的量化反馈作用，抑制 LLM 采样噪声。4) 训练：基于 GRPO，用组内标准化 ATR 作为整条轨迹所有 token 的优势，并对执行（tool call）token 施加掩码 M_{i,t}，仅对推理 token 回传梯度；含奖励裁剪 B=2、turn 惩罚 C_turn=0.0001 等超参。
AI.result: BIRD-Dev 上：Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 单轮二值 GRPO 58.5 → Agentic SQL 61.1 → +CSMR 62.5 → +CSMR+ATR 64.2（较二值 GRPO 提升 5.7%，Spider 上 +3.7%）；Spider2.0-Lite 从 6.6 提升至 8.8。以 OmniSQL-7B（Format-6k 冷启动 + BIRD/Spider 训练）为底座时达 69.1 / 88.8 / 17.7，超过同底座的 SQL-R1（66.6）与 SOTA Arctic-Text2SQL-R1-7B（67.6 / 15.6），Spider2.0 相比约 15% 的同类方法领先约 2.7 个点。消融显示：Agentic SQL 框架本身贡献最大（约 +3%）；对称矩阵变体降至 60.1，模型出现重复生成与循环；step-wise update 变体降至 61.3（且因各轮前缀上下文不同、无法按同一问题做组归一化，优势估计被削弱）；α 在 0.6/0.7/0.8 下性能差异极小（59.2/60.1/59.4），鲁棒性好。分析显示 BIRD 上 52.5% 的错误样本中约 13.7% 实为部分正确，二值奖励完全丢失该信息；ATR 使模型几乎放弃单轮生成，转向 2–3 轮且准确率最高。代价是 agentic rollout 与整体训练时间约为单轮的两倍（单次 RL 实验约 24 小时，32×A800）。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是把李雅普诺夫稳定性理论引入 RL 奖励设计：证明非对称转移矩阵使 ATR 成为能量耗散算子，从而在数学上保证无环策略与渐近稳定，配合 CSMR 提供的稠密过程信号，缓解 Agentic RL 中的信用分配与奖励稀疏问题。实验表明该框架在相同底座模型下超越 Arctic-Text2SQL-R1-7B 等 SOTA，推动 Text-to-SQL 走向稳健的多轮智能体范式。作者亦明确指出局限：多轮带来的约 2 倍计算与延迟开销；固定最多 3 次工具调用的有限交互时域限制了复杂企业级工作流；奖励设计仍依赖启发式超参（如停滞阈值 τ），迁移到不同架构/数据分布的数据库时需再调优。此外方法强依赖底座模型的探索能力，无法直接在过度专用化的 Qwen2.5-Coder 上启动。

title: Residual Stream Duality in Modern Transformer Architectures
summary: Recent work has made clear that the residual pathway is not mere optimization plumbing; it is part of the model's representational machinery. We agree, but argue that the cleanest way to organize this design space is through a two-axis view of the Transformer. A decoder evolves information along two ordered dimensions: sequence position and layer depth. Self-attention already provides adaptive mixing along the sequence axis, whereas the residual stream usually performs fixed addition along the depth axis. If we fix a token position and treat layer index as the ordered variable, then a causal depth-wise residual attention read is exactly the same local operator as causal short sliding-window attention (ShortSWA), except written over depth rather than over sequence. This is the core residual stream duality behind Transformer$^2$. This perspective also clarifies the recent literature. ELC-BERT and DenseFormer already show that learned aggregation over depth can outperform uniform residual accumulation, while Vertical Attention, DeepCrossAttention (DCA), MUDDFormer, and Attention Residuals move further toward explicit attention-based routing over earlier layers. The key point, however, is that operator-level duality does not imply systems-level symmetry. For large-scale autoregressive models, sequence-axis ShortSWA is usually the more hardware-friendly placement because it reuses token-side sliding-window kernels, KV-cache layouts, and chunked execution. If the goal is instead to change the shortcut itself, Deep Delta Learning (DDL) is the cleaner intervention because it modifies the residual operator directly rather than adding a separate cross-layer retrieval path. Our recommendation is therefore simple: use DDL when the shortcut is the object of interest, and use sequence-axis ShortSWA when the goal is local adaptive mixing.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Transformer的二维视角，将decoder视为沿序列位置和层深度两个有序维度演化信息。发现深度轴的残差注意力与序列轴的滑动窗注意力存在算子层面的对偶性，由此统一解释了ELC-BERT、DenseFormer、Vertical Attention、DCA、MUDDFormer、Attention Residuals等多种方法，并给出实用建议：修改shortcut用DDL，实现局部自适应混合用序列轴ShortSWA。
AI.motivation: 近期工作表明残差路径不仅是优化工具，而是模型表示机制的一部分。作者认为需要更清晰地组织Transformer设计空间，现有的各种改进方法缺乏统一的理论框架来理解它们之间的关系。
AI.method: 论文提出将Transformer视为沿两个有序维度（序列位置和层深度）演化信息的系统。通过将token位置固定、层索引作为有序变量，发现因果深度残差注意力读取与因果短滑动窗口注意力(ShortSWA)在算子层面是等价的（只是维度不同）。基于此分析了ELC-BERT、DenseFormer、Vertical Attention、DeepCrossAttention(DCA)、MUDDFormer、Attention Residuals和Deep Delta Learning(DDL)等方法。
AI.result: 论文澄清了多个相关方法的内在联系：ELC-BERT和DenseFormer表明深度学习聚合可优于均匀残差积累；Vertical Attention、DCA、MUDDFormer和Attention Residuals采用显式注意力路由。关键发现是算子层面的二元性不等于系统层面的对称性——对于大规模自回归模型，序列轴ShortSWA更硬件友好，因其可复用token侧滑动窗口内核、KV-cache布局和分块执行；而DDL是更干净的干预方式，直接修改残差算子而非添加跨层检索路径。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出的残差流二元性观点为Transformer设计空间提供了统一框架，建议在需要修改shortcut时使用DDL，在需要局部自适应混合时使用序列轴ShortSWA。这一视角澄清了近期文献中多种看似不同的方法实则具有内在联系。

title: Are Large Language Models Truly Smarter Than Humans?
summary: Public leaderboards increasingly suggest that large language models (LLMs) surpass human experts on benchmarks spanning academic knowledge, law, and programming. Yet most benchmarks are fully public, their questions widely mirrored across the internet, creating systematic risk that models were trained on the very data used to evaluate them. This paper presents three complementary experiments forming a rigorous multi-method contamination audit of six frontier LLMs: GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, DeepSeek-R1, DeepSeek-V3, Llama-3.3-70B, and Qwen3-235B. Experiment 1 applies a lexical contamination detection pipeline to 513 MMLU questions across all 57 subjects, finding an overall contamination rate of 13.8% (18.1% in STEM, up to 66.7% in Philosophy) and estimated performance gains of +0.030 to +0.054 accuracy points by category. Experiment 2 applies a paraphrase and indirect-reference diagnostic to 100 MMLU questions, finding accuracy drops by an average of 7.0 percentage points under indirect reference, rising to 19.8 pp in both Law and Ethics. Experiment 3 applies TS-Guessing behavioral probes to all 513 questions and all six models, finding that 72.5% trigger memorization signals far above chance, with DeepSeek-R1 displaying a distributed memorization signature (76.6% partial reconstruction, 0% verbatim recall) that explains its anomalous Experiment 2 profile. All three experiments converge on the same contamination ranking: STEM > Professional > Social Sciences > Humanities.

AI.tldr: 该论文对六个前沿LLM进行了严格的多方法污染审计，通过三种互补实验揭示了基准测试数据污染的严重程度。实验发现MMLU基准存在13.8%的词汇污染率，在间接引用条件下准确率平均下降7.0个百分点，72.5%的查询触发记忆信号。所有实验一致显示污染排名为：STEM > 专业 > 社会科学 > 人文。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在各种基准测试中表现超越人类专家，但大多数基准完全公开，问题广泛存在于互联网上，存在模型在训练数据中包含评估数据的系统性风险。这种污染使得模型性能评估不可靠，需要严格的污染审计方法。
AI.method: 三种互补实验方法：(1) 词汇污染检测管道应用于513道MMLU问题；(2) 释义和间接引用诊断应用于100道MMLU问题；(3) TS-Guessing行为探测应用于所有513道问题和6个模型。
AI.result: 实验1发现总体污染率13.8%（STEM领域18.1%，哲学高达66.7%），估计性能提升+0.030至+0.054准确率点。实验2发现间接引用条件下准确率平均下降7.0个百分点，法律和伦理领域下降19.8个百分点。实验3发现72.5%触发远高于随机水平的记忆信号，DeepSeek-R1显示分布式记忆特征（76.6%部分重构，0%逐字回忆）。
AI.conclusion: 三种实验方法一致得出污染排名：STEM > 专业 > 社会科学 > 人文。研究强调了开发更robust的基准测试方法的紧迫性，以及需要更严格的模型评估协议来应对数据污染问题。

title: Collaborative Temporal Feature Generation via Critic-Free Reinforcement Learning for Cross-User Sensor-Based Activity Recognition
summary: Human Activity Recognition using wearable inertial sensors is foundational to healthcare monitoring, fitness analytics, and context-aware computing, yet its deployment is hindered by cross-user variability arising from heterogeneous physiological traits, motor habits, and sensor placements. Existing domain generalization approaches either neglect temporal dependencies in sensor streams or depend on impractical target-domain annotations. We propose a different paradigm: modeling generalizable feature extraction as a collaborative sequential generation process governed by reinforcement learning. Our framework, CTFG (Collaborative Temporal Feature Generation), employs a Transformer-based autoregressive generator that incrementally constructs feature token sequences, each conditioned on prior context and the encoded sensor input. The generator is optimized via Group-Relative Policy Optimization, a critic-free algorithm that evaluates each generated sequence against a cohort of alternatives sampled from the same input, deriving advantages through intra-group normalization rather than learned value estimation. This design eliminates the distribution-dependent bias inherent in critic-based methods and provides self-calibrating optimization signals that remain stable across heterogeneous user distributions. A tri-objective reward comprising class discrimination, cross-user invariance, and temporal fidelity jointly shapes the feature space to separate activities, align user distributions, and preserve fine-grained temporal content. Evaluations on the DSADS and PAMAP2 benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art cross-user accuracy (88.53\% and 75.22\%), substantial reduction in inter-task training variance, accelerated convergence, and robust generalization under varying action-space dimensionalities.

AI.tldr: CTFG是一种基于强化学习的域泛化框架，用于可穿戴惯性传感器的人类活动识别，通过Transformer自回归生成器与群体相对策略优化实现跨用户泛化，在DSADS和PAMAP2数据集上达到88.53%和75.22%的跨用户准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有域泛化方法要么忽视传感器流中的时间依赖性，要么依赖不切实际的目标域标注。跨用户变异性（由生理特征、运动习惯和传感器放置差异导致）阻碍了HAR系统的实际部署。
AI.method: 提出CTFG框架：1) 基于Transformer的自回归生成器，逐步构建特征标记序列；2) 群体相对策略优化(GRPO)，通过组内归一化而非学习值估计评估生成序列，消除了基于批评器方法的分布相关偏差；三目标奖励包括类别区分度、跨用户不变性和时间保真度。
AI.result: 在DSADS和PAMAP2基准数据集上实现最先进的跨用户准确率（88.53%和75.22%），显著降低任务间训练方差，加速收敛，并在不同动作空间维度下表现出稳健的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将可泛化特征提取建模为协作式序列生成过程，CTFG成功解决了HAR中的跨用户变异性问题，无需目标域标注即可实现鲁棒的域泛化。

title: Proactive Rejection and Grounded Execution: A Dual-Stage Intent Analysis Paradigm for Safe and Efficient AIoT Smart Homes
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) transition from information providers to embodied agents in the Internet of Things (IoT), they face significant challenges regarding reliability and interaction efficiency. Direct execution of LLM-generated commands often leads to entity hallucinations (e.g., trying to control non-existent devices). Meanwhile, existing iterative frameworks (e.g., SAGE) suffer from the Interaction Frequency Dilemma, oscillating between reckless execution and excessive user questioning. To address these issues, we propose a Dual-Stage Intent-Aware (DS-IA) Framework. This framework separates high-level user intent understanding from low-level physical execution. Specifically, Stage 1 serves as a semantic firewall to filter out invalid instructions and resolve vague commands by checking the current state of the home. Stage 2 then employs a deterministic cascade verifier-a strict, step-by-step rule checker that verifies the room, device, and capability in sequence-to ensure the action is actually physically possible before execution. Extensive experiments on the HomeBench and SAGE benchmarks demonstrate that DS-IA achieves an Exact Match (EM) rate of 58.56% (outperforming baselines by over 28%) and improves the rejection rate of invalid instructions to 87.04%. Evaluations on the SAGE benchmark further reveal that DS-IA resolves the Interaction Frequency Dilemma by balancing proactive querying with state-based inference. Specifically, it boosts the Autonomous Success Rate (resolving tasks without unnecessary user intervention) from 42.86% to 71.43%, while maintaining high precision in identifying irreducible ambiguities that truly necessitate human clarification. These results underscore the framework's ability to minimize user disturbance through accurate environmental grounding.

AI.tldr: DS-IA框架通过双阶段设计(语义防火墙+确定性级联验证器)解决LLM在物联网中的实体幻觉和交互频率困境，在两项基准上实现EM率58.56%和自主成功率71.43%的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型(LLM)从信息提供者转变为物联网中的具身智能体面临两大核心挑战：1)实体幻觉问题—直接执行LLM生成的命令导致控制不存在设备的错误；2)交互频率困境—现有迭代框架(如SAGE)在鲁莽执行与过度询问之间振荡。
AI.method: 提出双阶段意图感知(DS-IA)框架，将高层用户意图理解与低层物理执行分离。阶段一作为语义防火墙，通过检查家居当前状态过滤无效指令并解析模糊命令。阶段二采用确定性级联验证器，严格按步骤检查房间、设备和能力，验证动作在物理上是否可行后再执行。
AI.result: 在HomeBench和SAGE基准上的广泛实验表明：1)DS-IA达到58.56%的精确匹配率(比基线提升超过28%)；2)无效指令拒绝率提升至87.04%；3)自主成功率从42.86%提升至71.43%，同时保持高精度识别真正需要人工澄清的不可约模糊性。
AI.conclusion: DS-IA框架通过语义过滤和确定性级联验证两个阶段，有效解决了LLM在物联网场景中的实体幻觉问题和交互频率困境。实验表明，该框架在HomeBench和SAGE基准上均取得显著提升：EM率达到58.56%，无效指令拒绝率达87.04%，自主成功率从42.86%提升至71.43%，同时保持了高精度识别真正需要人工澄清的不可约模糊性。这些结果验证了框架通过准确环境接地来最小化用户干扰的能力。

title: Adaptive regularization parameter selection for high-dimensional inverse problems: A Bayesian approach with Tucker low-rank constraints
summary: This paper introduces a novel variational Bayesian method that integrates Tucker decomposition for efficient high-dimensional inverse problem solving. The method reduces computational complexity by transforming variational inference from a high-dimensional space to a lower-dimensional core tensor space via Tucker decomposition. A key innovation is the introduction of per-mode precision parameters, enabling adaptive regularization for anisotropic structures. For instance, in directional image deblurring, learned parameters align with physical anisotropy, applying stronger regularization to critical directions (e.g., row vs. column axes). The method further estimates noise levels from data, eliminating reliance on prior knowledge of noise parameters (unlike conventional benchmarks such as the discrepancy principle (DP)). Experimental evaluations across 2D deblurring, 3D heat conduction, and Fredholm integral equations demonstrate consistent improvements in quantitative metrics (PSNR, SSIM) and qualitative visualizations (error maps, precision parameter trends) compared to L-curve criterion, generalized cross-validation (GCV), unbiased predictive risk estimator (UPRE), and DP. The approach scales to problems with 110,000 variables and outperforms existing methods by 0.73-2.09 dB in deblurring tasks and 6.75 dB in 3D heat conduction. Limitations include sensitivity to rank selection in Tucker decomposition and the need for theoretical analysis. Future work will explore automated rank selection and theoretical guarantees. This method bridges Bayesian theory and scalable computation, offering practical solutions for large-scale inverse problems in imaging, remote sensing, and scientific computing.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合Tucker分解的变分贝叶斯方法，用于高效求解高维逆问题。该方法通过Tucker分解将变分推断从高维空间转换到低维核心张量空间以降低计算复杂度，并引入每模态精度参数实现自适应正则化，同时从数据中估计噪声水平。实验表明该方法在2D去模糊、3D热传导和Fredholm积分方程问题上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 高维逆问题中传统变分贝叶斯方法计算复杂度高，且需要预先知道噪声参数（如基于差异原则的方法）。此外，现有的正则化方法难以有效处理各向异性结构，如图像去模糊中不同方向的模糊核不同。
AI.method: 提出一种结合Tucker分解的变分贝叶斯方法：(1)利用Tucker分解将高维空间变分推断转换为低维核心张量空间的推断，显著降低计算复杂度；(2)引入每模态精度参数实现对各向异性结构的自适应正则化；(3)直接从数据中估计噪声水平，无需先验知识。
AI.result: 在2D去模糊任务中比L-curve、GCV、UPRE和DP方法提升0.73-2.09 dB；在3D热传导问题中提升6.75 dB；可扩展至110,000个变量的问题。定性实验表明误差图和精度参数趋势图均验证了方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功桥接了贝叶斯理论与可扩展计算，为成像、遥感和科学计算中的大规模逆问题提供了实用解决方案。局限性在于对Tucker分解秩选择敏感，且缺乏理论分析，未来将探索自动秩选择和理论保证。

title: MOSAIC: Composable Safety Alignment with Modular Control Tokens
summary: Safety alignment in large language models (LLMs) is commonly implemented as a single static policy embedded in model parameters. However, real-world deployments often require context-dependent safety rules that vary across users, regions, and applications. Existing approaches struggle to provide such conditional control: parameter-level alignment entangles safety behaviors with general capabilities, while prompt-based methods rely on natural language instructions that provide weak enforcement. We propose MOSAIC, a modular framework that enables compositional safety alignment through learnable control tokens optimized over a frozen backbone model. Each token represents a safety constraint and can be flexibly activated and composed at inference time. To train compositional tokens efficiently, we introduce order-based task sampling and a distribution-level alignment objective that mitigates over-refusal. Experiments show that MOSAIC achieves strong defense performance with substantially lower over-refusal while preserving model utility.

AI.tldr: MOSAIC是一个模块化框架，通过可学习的控制令牌实现LLM的组合式安全对齐，支持在推理时灵活激活和组合安全约束。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐方法存在局限性：参数级对齐将安全行为与通用能力纠缠在一起，基于提示的方法依赖自然语言指令且执行力度弱。实际部署需要根据用户、地区和应用场景动态调整安全规则。
AI.method: 提出两种关键技术：1) 基于顺序的任务采样（order-based task sampling），用于高效训练组合令牌；2) 分布级对齐目标（distribution-level alignment objective），缓解过度拒绝问题。框架冻结骨干模型，仅优化控制令牌的嵌入表示。
AI.result: 实验表明MOSAIC实现了强大的防御性能，同时大幅降低过度拒绝，并保持模型效用。
AI.conclusion: MOSAIC通过可学习的控制令牌实现了模块化、可组合的安全对齐框架，在保持模型实用性的同时显著降低了过度拒绝问题。

title: MDM-Prime-v2: Binary Encoding and Index Shuffling Enable Compute-optimal Scaling of Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion models (MDM) exhibit superior generalization when learned using a Partial masking scheme (Prime). This approach converts tokens into sub-tokens and models the diffusion process at the sub-token level. We identify two limitations of the MDM-Prime framework. First, we lack tools to guide the hyperparameter choice of the token granularity in the subtokenizer. Second, we find that the function form of the subtokenizer significantly degrades likelihood estimation when paired with commonly used Byte-Pair-Encoding (BPE) tokenizers. To address these limitations, we study the tightness of the variational bound in MDM-Prime and develop MDM-Prime-v2, a masked diffusion language model which incorporates Binary Encoding and Index Shuffling. Our scaling analysis reveals that MDM-Prime-v2 is 21.8$\times$ more compute-efficient than autoregressive models (ARM). In compute-optimal comparisons, MDM-Prime-v2 achieves 7.77 perplexity on OpenWebText, outperforming ARM (12.99), MDM (18.94), and MDM-Prime (13.41). When extending the model size to 1.1B parameters, our model further demonstrates superior zero-shot accuracy on various commonsense reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MDM-Prime-v2，通过引入二元编码和索引洗牌技术解决掩码扩散模型在语言建模中的局限。在OpenWebText上达到7.77困惑度，比自回归模型(12.99)、MDM(18.94)和MDM-Prime(13.41)更优，计算效率提升21.8倍。
AI.motivation: MDM-Prime框架存在两个关键问题：1)缺乏工具指导子标记器的token粒度超参数选择；2)与BPE标记器结合时功能形式显著降低似然估计性能。
AI.method: 1. 研究MDM-Prime中变分界的紧度；2. 提出MDM-Prime-v2，集成Binary Encoding和Index Shuffling技术；3. 进行扩展性分析。
AI.result: MDM-Prime-v2在计算优化比较中达到7.77困惑度(OpenWebText)，优于ARM(12.99)、MDM(18.94)和MDM-Prime(13.41)。1.1B参数模型在常识推理零样本任务上展现优异性能。
AI.conclusion: MDM-Prime-v2成功解决了掩码扩散模型在token粒度选择和BPE兼容性方面的问题，在困惑度和计算效率上均显著超越自回归模型和前代MDM方法。

title: Adaptive Theory of Mind for LLM-based Multi-Agent Coordination
summary: Theory of Mind (ToM) refers to the ability to reason about others' mental states, and higher-order ToM involves considering that others also possess their own ToM. Equipping large language model (LLM)-driven agents with ToM has long been considered to improve their coordination in multiagent collaborative tasks. However, we find that misaligned ToM orders-mismatches in the depth of ToM reasoning between agents-can lead to insufficient or excessive reasoning about others, thereby impairing their coordination. To address this issue, we design an adaptive ToM (A-ToM) agent, which can align in ToM orders with its partner. Based on prior interactions, the agent estimates the partner's likely ToM order and leverages this estimation to predict the partner's action, thereby facilitating behavioral coordination. We conduct empirical evaluations on four multi-agent coordination tasks: a repeated matrix game, two grid navigation tasks and an Overcooked task. The results validate our findings on ToM alignment and demonstrate the effectiveness of our A-ToM agent. Furthermore, we discuss the generalizability of our A-ToM to non-LLM-based agents, as well as what would diminish the importance of ToM alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM驱动智能体中ToM阶数错位对多智能体协作的影响，提出自适应ToM (A-ToM)智能体，通过估计合作伙伴的ToM阶数并自适应调整自身推理深度来提升协调效果，在四种任务上验证了方法有效性。
AI.motivation: 为LLM驱动的智能体配备心智理论(ToM)被认为可以提升多智能体协作任务中的协调能力，但研究发现ToM阶数错位（智能体之间ToM推理深度不匹配）会导致对他人推理不足或过度，从而损害协调效果。
AI.method: 设计自适应ToM (A-ToM)智能体，基于先验交互估计合作伙伴的ToM阶数，利用该估计预测合作伙伴的行动，从而实现行为协调。
AI.result: 在四种多智能体协调任务（重复矩阵博弈、两个网格导航任务和Overcooked任务）上的实证评估验证了关于ToM对齐的发现，并证明了A-ToM智能体的有效性。
AI.conclusion: A-ToM agent通过估计合作伙伴的ToM阶数并据此调整自身推理深度，能够有效解决ToM阶数错位问题，显著提升多智能体协作任务中的协调效果。该方法在四种不同类型的任务中均表现出有效性，并且具有推广到非LLM智能体的潜力。

title: A Depth-Aware Comparative Study of Euclidean and Hyperbolic Graph Neural Networks on Bitcoin Transaction Systems
summary: Bitcoin transaction networks are large scale socio- technical systems in which activities are represented through multi-hop interaction patterns. Graph Neural Networks(GNNs) have become a widely adopted tool for analyzing such systems, supporting tasks such as entity detection and transaction classification. Large-scale datasets like Elliptic have allowed for a rise in the analysis of these systems and in tasks such as fraud detection. In these settings, the amount of transactional context available to each node is determined by the neighborhood aggregation and sampling strategies, yet the interaction between these receptive fields and embedding geometry has received limited attention. In this work, we conduct a controlled comparison of Euclidean and tangent-space hyperbolic GNNs for node classification on a large Bitcoin transaction graph. By explicitly varying the neighborhood while keeping the model architecture and dimensionality fixed, we analyze the differences in two embedding spaces. We further examine optimization behavior and observe that joint selection of learning rate and curvature plays a critical role in stabilizing high-dimensional hyperbolic embeddings. Overall, our findings provide practical insights into the role of embedding geometry and neighborhood depth when modeling large-scale transaction networks, informing the deployment of hyperbolic GNNs for computational social systems.

AI.tldr: 本文在大规模比特币交易图（Schnoering & Vazirgiannis 重建图，约2.52亿节点/7.85亿边、3.4万有标签节点、7类实体）上，对欧氏 GNN 与切空间双曲 GNN（GCN/GraphSAGE/GAT 各2层与3层）在固定嵌入维度 d=256、相同预处理与固定扇出邻域采样条件下做受控对比节点分类实验。结论：双曲模型在宏平均F1上持续优于欧氏模型，且优势在更深的3层架构下更明显（深度2子图：HGraphSAGE 0.80 vs 最佳欧氏 0.73；深度3子图：0.81 vs 0.78），增益主要出现在 Exchange/Gambling/Mining/Ponzi/Ransomware 等结构模糊的难分类别；优化稳定性高度依赖曲率，c≥1.0 时对学习率不敏感（c=1.25 下验证F1仅在0.748–0.821间波动），c<0.5 时无论学习率如何都会收敛到劣质解。双曲变体的额外开销仅为 O(V·d) 元素级映射，与欧氏 O(E·d²) 同阶，在4节点RTX 5070 Ti集群上可实用。
AI.motivation: 比特币交易网络是大规模社会-技术系统，洗钱、勒索、庞氏骗局等非法活动往往表现为多跳、分叉式（fan-out）的链式或树状交易模式，而非孤立交互。当 GNN 扩大邻域感受野以捕捉这类多跳上下文时，欧氏空间中的体积随半径呈多项式增长，节点表示必须在固定维度内压缩大规模分叉邻域，容易产生拥挤效应与表征失真；而双曲空间具有负曲率与指数级体积增长，理论上更适合编码树状/分支结构。已有研究多在整图上训练或固定名义感受野，普遍缺少对"采样邻域深度 × 嵌入几何"这一交互作用的系统性受控比较，也缺少针对大规模金融交易图的超曲 GNN 评估；同时随着深度增加还会带来过平滑问题。缺口在于：在同一架构与维度下，单独改变采样深度，能否让双曲几何的表示优势真正显现并被量化？
AI.method: 数据集：Schnoering 和 Vazirgiannis 的大规模比特币交易图重建（约2.52亿节点、7.85亿有向边），取3.4万个有标签节点，7个实体类别（Exchange、Mining、Gambling、Ponzi、Individual、Ransomware、Bet），分层划分训练40%/验证30%/测试30%，仅在训练集上做随机过采样使每类300样本以缓解严重类别不平衡。子图采样：为每个种子节点构建固定的自中心子图 G_v^(k)，两档深度——深度2（扇出{1:5, 2:10}）与深度3（扇出{1:5, 2:10, 3:8}），每个节点仅一个固定子图（区别于原文献的邻域缓冲与多样本增强），以排除采样方差干扰；深度增加代表"采样交易暴露量"增加而非完整结构扩展。特征：沿用原文献流水线，原始交易特征加派生特征（平均收/发金额、出入度比、聚类成分比、节点年龄、按年龄归一化的活跃率），satoshi 按节点生命周期中位汇率折算美元；五阶段归一化（零值置NaN→log变换→基于0%/95%百分位（值型特征用5%）的min-max归一化→截断到[0,1]→NaN补0），所有归一化常数仅由训练集计算以防泄漏。模型：六种模型 = 3种架构（GCN、GraphSAGE、GAT）× 2种几何（欧氏 ℝ^d；双曲 Poincaré 球 B_c^d），统一 d=256，2层与3层两种配置，Adam、lr=0.001、dropout 0.1，GAT 用双变换注意力、8头（每头32维）、末层单头；仅在种子节点上计算损失。双曲变体采用切空间形式：输入经 exp_0^c 投影到 Poincaré 球，聚合在 Klein 坐标做均值（KleinAgg），变换在切空间线性层完成后经 exp_0^c 映回；HyperbolicGAT 的注意力系数由经双变换后的负双曲距离 softmax 得到；末层去掉 ReLU 并输出切空间 logits。曲率 c ∈ {0.1,0.3,0.5,0.75,1.0,1.25,1.5} 依据验证集选择。评测：precision/recall/F1 的逐类与宏平均，以宏平均F1为主指标；另做曲率×学习率联合网格搜索分析优化行为；计算环境为4节点集群（每节点RTX 5070 Ti 16GB），子图构建为CPU SLURM 数组作业、PostgreSQL 图存储上的磁盘支持多跳遍历离线预处理。
AI.result: 1）宏平均F1：双曲在两种采样深度、两种层数下一致占优。深度2子图上2层时双曲与欧氏接近（GCN 0.55→HGCN 0.59；GraphSAGE 0.72→0.76；GAT 0.71→0.75）；加入第三层后差距扩大，HGraphSAGE 达0.80，最佳欧氏（GraphSAGE）仅0.73。深度3子图上，2层时HGCN 0.64 > GCN 0.58，GraphSAGE 0.77 与HGAT 0.77 略高于HGraphSAGE 0.76；3层时HGraphSAGE/HGAT 均达0.81，高于GraphSAGE/GAT 0.78与GCN 0.64（双曲GCN 0.68）。说明双曲优势主要出现在"深架构 + 中等深度子图"的组合，无需极大邻域即可显现，且跨深度保持稳定。2）逐类分析：Bet、Individual等高频易分类别各模型已近乎饱和（F1>0.91），几何差异微乎其微；难类别增益明显——Ponzi 的 HGraphSAGE 精度0.74→0.84、F1 0.65→0.72，Gambling 最高召回 0.78（HGAT）vs 0.75（GraphSAGE），Mining 与 Exchange 的F1分别提升约0.05与0.04，Ransomware F1 最高0.70（HGAT）vs 0.67（GraphSAGE）。即双曲的收益是跨类别的普遍性改善，而非集中于欺诈类。3）优化行为：曲率为主导因素，c<0.5 时无论学习率均收敛到劣质局部最优（c=0.10 下学习率区间引起0.59的F1波动，0.117–0.708；LR=1e-4 时 c=0.50 为0.353 而 c=0.75 为0.612）；c≥1.0 使优化对学习率稳健（c=1.25 时验证F1仅在0.748–0.821间波动），存在 c=0.75–1.25 的过渡区。学习率作用次要，低曲率下高学习率可部分补偿但不可靠。4）复杂度：欧氏 O(E·d²)，双曲额外映射为 O(V·d) 且 V·d ≪ E·d²，故渐近同阶；双曲因超越函数（log/exp）耗时与显存略高。5）理论解释：固定扇出采样诱导树状膨胀，欧氏空间体积多项式增长导致分支路径拥挤难以分离，双曲的指数体积增长为分支保留更大分离容量；而随深度提升的边际收益有限，源于固定扇出采样只覆盖邻域子集、增 hops 不必然带来更丰富结构信息，甚至可能失真。
AI.conclusion: 在受控条件下，欧氏与切空间双曲 GNN 的大规模比特币交易分类对比显示：双曲表示在捕捉分叉式多跳交易模式上系统性优于欧氏，且优势随网络层数加深而扩大，双曲增益跨类别分布而非集中于个别欺诈实体（高频易分类别已近饱和）；双曲优化的成败主要由曲率决定，c≥1.0 可在宽学习率范围内获得稳定结果，而c<0.5 必然欠训练/陷入劣解，因此曲率与学习率必须联合选择。工程上，切空间形式将双曲模型的开销控制在与欧氏同阶的渐近复杂度内，使超曲 GNN 在大规模金融交易图上可行。结论是：欧氏 GNN 已能满足许多区块链应用需求，但开发实体识别与欺诈检测方法时必须显式考虑嵌入空间的几何属性。局限与未来方向：仅研究静态交易图，未建模时间动态与超出采样邻域的依赖；使用固定曲率的切空间形式以换取数值稳定性与可扩展性；未来可扩展到时间建模、自适应/混合几何表示、其他邻域采样策略、其他区块链或金融交易系统，以及早期欺诈检测、风险评估等下游取证任务。

title: NeSy-Route: A Neuro-Symbolic Benchmark for Constrained Route Planning in Remote Sensing
summary: Remote sensing underpins crucial applications such as disaster relief and ecological field surveys, where systems must understand complex scenes and constraints and make reliable decisions. Current remote-sensing benchmarks mainly focus on evaluating perception and reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). They fail to assess planning capability, stemming either from the difficulty of curating and validating planning tasks at scale or from evaluation protocols that are inaccurate and inadequate. To address these limitations, we introduce NeSy-Route, a large-scale neuro-symbolic benchmark for constrained route planning in remote sensing. Within this benchmark, we introduce an automated data-generation framework that integrates high-fidelity semantic masks with heuristic search to produce diverse route-planning tasks with provably optimal solutions. This allows NeSy-Route to comprehensively evaluate planning across 10,821 route-planning samples, nearly 10 times larger than the largest prior benchmark. Furthermore, a three-level hierarchical neuro-symbolic evaluation protocol is developed to enable accurate assessment and support fine-grained analysis on perception, reasoning, and planning simultaneously. Our comprehensive evaluation of various state-of-the-art MLLMs demonstrates that existing MLLMs show significant deficiencies in perception and planning capabilities. We hope NeSy-Route can support further research and development of more powerful MLLMs for remote sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NeSy-Route，一个用于遥感约束路径规划的大规模神经符号基准测试，包含10,821个路径规划样本，并设计了三级层次化神经符号评估协议，用于同时评估感知、推理和规划能力。
AI.motivation: 当前遥感基准测试主要评估多模态大语言模型(MLLM)的感知和推理能力，缺乏规划能力评估，主要原因是：1)大规模规划任务整理和验证困难；2)评估协议不准确和不充分。
AI.method: 1. 提出自动化数据生成框架，整合高保真语义掩码与启发式搜索，生成具有可证明最优解的多样化路径规划任务；2. 构建三级层次化神经符号评估协议，支持感知、推理和规划的细粒度分析。
AI.result: 对多种先进MLLM的综合评估表明，现有MLLM在感知和规划能力方面存在显著不足。
AI.conclusion: NeSy-Route是首个大规模遥感约束路径规划基准测试，规模约为此前最大基准的10倍，为遥感领域更强大的MLLM研发提供支持。

title: Functorial Neural Architectures from Higher Inductive Types
comment: 20 pages, 10 tables. Code and Cubical Agda formalization: https://github.com/karsar/hott_neuro
summary: Neural networks systematically fail at compositional generalization -- producing correct outputs for novel combinations of known parts. We show that this failure is architectural: compositional generalization is equivalent to functoriality of the decoder, and this perspective yields both guarantees and impossibility results. We compile Higher Inductive Type (HIT) specifications into neural architectures via a monoidal functor from the path groupoid of a target space to a category of parametric maps: path constructors become generator networks, composition becomes structural concatenation, and 2-cells witnessing group relations become learned natural transformations. We prove that decoders assembled by structural concatenation of independently generated segments are strict monoidal functors (compositional by construction), while softmax self-attention is not functorial for any non-trivial compositional task. Both results are formalized in Cubical Agda. Experiments on three spaces validate the full hierarchy: on the torus ($\mathbb{Z}^2$), functorial decoders outperform non-functorial ones by 2-2.7x; on $S^1 \vee S^1$ ($F_2$), the type-A/B gap widens to 5.5-10x; on the Klein bottle ($\mathbb{Z} \rtimes \mathbb{Z}$), a learned 2-cell closes a 46% error gap on words exercising the group relation.

AI.tldr: 本文主张「组合泛化失败是架构性的」：解码器只有在尊重任务的代数律（即从自由生成的自由幺半群下降到商）时才算组合泛化。作者给出一个「编译」框架——把高阶归纳类型（HIT）规格编译成神经架构：基点→基点约束，路径构造子→生成元网络，复合→结构拼接，2-元胞（见证群关系的同伦）→可学习的自然变换。证明 transport 解码器按构造即为严格幺半函子，而 softmax 自注意力在任何参数下都不可能同时满足严格分解与下降（对非平凡商）。三个拓扑空间（环面 ℤ²、楔和 S¹∨S¹、自由群 F₂、克莱因瓶 ℤ⋊ℤ）实验验证：函子型解码器比非函子型好 2–10×，且在克莱因瓶上学习到的 2-元胞在「触发群关系的词」上闭合 46% 误差缺口。核心结论在 Cubical Agda 中形式化。
AI.motivation: 神经网络能学到任务的「零件」，却无法泛化到零件的新颖组合（SCAN、COGS、多步算术），且该失败随模型规模增大而不消失，作者认为这不是容量问题而是架构问题。具体而言，若解码器对复合输入的处理可分解为「各部分独立生成再合并」，即 𝒟(w₁·w₂)=𝒟(w₁)⊕𝒟(w₂)，这在范畴语言中恰是输入幺半群到输出范畴的幺半函子；而组合语义必须是函子性的（DisCoCat 传统），且不同等价类词（如 ab 与 ba）必须给出同一输出，即还须「下降」到由关系决定的商 G=F/⟨r₁,…,r_m⟩。既有工作（categorical deep learning、DisCoCat）只提供分析视角：为某个具体组合结构（如 ℤ²、F₂）构造真正函子性的架构仍靠手工工程、无法保证其确实是函子。作者要补上缺失的一环——一个从类型论规格到神经架构的编译函子，使任务的代数结构自动决定架构，组合正确性由构造保证而非事后正则化。
AI.method: 1) 规格语言：以 HoTT 的高阶归纳类型给出三个空间的 HIT 规格——环面（基点、loop_a、loop_b、surf 见证交换）、楔和圆（两个 loop，无 2-元胞）、克莱因瓶（基点、loop_a、loop_b、rel 见证 b·a·b⁻¹=a⁻¹）。2) 范畴化：把自由幺半群 F 视为离散严格幺半范畴（对象=词，幺半积=拼接），把 π₁ 的元素视为同一离散严格幺半范畴的商；目标范畴取参数映射范畴 Para(Smooth) 的严格化，并定义 loop 范畴 ParLoop(X)：对象=满足基点边界条件的参数化回路 (Θ,L)，幺半积=回路拼接 ⊕（参数空间取笛卡尔积），按 [0,1] 重参数化取商以获得严格结合律。3) 编译函子（构造 3.2）：𝒟(g,H): F⟨a₁,…,a_k⟩ → ParLoop(X)，词 w 映为各生成元网络 g_{a_i^ε} 的顺序拼接；生成元网络为 2 层 MLP（128 隐单元），带硬性绕数（winding）约束 [g_a_i]=[a_i]∈π₁；每条关系配一个 2 层 MLP 同伦 H_j，边界条件为 H_j(·,0,t)=𝒟(LHS_j)(t)、H_j(·,1,t)=𝒟(RHS_j)(t)（实现中采用等长形式 b·a=a⁻¹·b），与生成元联合训练。4) 类型学分类：type-B（函子型）= 结构拼接独立生成段；type-A（非函子型）= 存在跨段信息流（Transformer WC、transport-attention）或完全缺少单子分解（cover，按同调类各配一个网络）、或依赖累积上下文（GRU）。5) 证明：定理 3.3（transport 为严格幺半函子且经 H_j 下降）、定理 4.1（softmax 注意力不能同时满足 (i) 严格函子性与 (ii) 下降）、附录 F 的定理 F.2（去掉群结构的一般不可能性：注意力在首个自注意力层即违反「跨段独立」，softmax 权重严格为正故只能近似不能精确）、附录 H 的深度阻碍三分律（阿贝尔/可解非阿贝尔/非可解，Barrington 的 NC¹ 与 AC⁰ 之别、Liu 等的可解群常深度捷径）、附录 G 由群论导出 transport-structured 位置编码并归约为多维 RoPE。6) 形式化：Cubical Agda（v2.6.4，--cubical --safe，无 postulate）四个模块 Torus.agda、WedgeOfCircles.agda、TransportCoherence.agda、NonCompositionality.agda。7) 实验：连续几何生成任务（输入词→输出与该同调类一致的点云回路），训练词长度 ≤2（环面/楔和 6 词，克莱因瓶 16 词含逆元），测试长度 3/4/6/8/10（最高 5× 长度外推）；Chamfer 距离损失 + AdamW（lr=1e-3，wd=1e-4，cosine 调度，≤500 epoch，早停 patience 80），主指标为「每段 Chamfer 距离」d̄_L = (1/L)Σ d_C(γ̂_i, γ_i)（每段重采样至 32 点），楔和另测「圆归属准确率」，3 个随机种子；另有匹配损失消融、连贯性（coherence）探针（交换性/非规范词间隙应为精确 0）、顺序敏感度测试。
AI.result: 理论侧：(1) transport 解码器是 F 到 ParLoop(X) 的严格幺半函子，且经学习到的同伦 H_j 下降为 G 上的伪函子（对任意参数、任意词长成立）；(2) 含至少一层 softmax 自注意力的解码器在任何参数下都无法同时满足严格分解与下降——因为注意力按 token 内容（键向量 Kh_j）路由，等价类的不同词会产生不同的跨段注意力权重，从而破坏 w₁ 段输出只依赖 𝒟(w₂) 的要求；更强的 F.2 表明即使没有群结构、非组合性也源于架构本身，且学习到的组合性只能是近似的、依赖分布的、无长度迁移保证的；(3) 深度阻碍只在非可解商上额外出现（F₂↠S₅ 的前缀积为 NC¹ 完全，超出固定深度 Transformer 的 AC⁰ 能力），可解群（ℤ⋊ℤ）只需归因于函子性阻碍。实验侧：环面上 type-B 的 d̄_10 为 0.77–0.80，type-A 为 1.54–2.09（2–2.7×），其中拥有等变位置编码、共享绕数约束且参数多 3.4× 的 transport-attention 仍然退化，说明「正确条件化 ≠ 正确组合」；cover 虽绕数正确却停滞（2.15→1.91），说明同调类正确是必要非充分条件；楔和圆上差距拉大到 5.5–10×（transport 0.054 vs Transformer 0.537 vs GRU 0.297），且圆归属准确率 transport 恒为 100%，Transformer 从 33%（训练长度 L=2）跌到 14%，属拓扑性坍塌而非单纯外推失败；GRU 虽具备正确深度结构，仍因上下文依赖而非结构组合而退化（0.010→0.297，30×）；克莱因瓶上学习到的 2-元胞在非规范词上把 1.52 降到 0.82（1.85×，闭合 46% 缺口），而在不触发关系的规范词上与 transport 无差异（0.84 vs 0.82），证明改进来自关系本身而非额外容量，并消除了规范/非规范的不对称（1.8×→1.0×）；匹配损失消融显示加倍 epoch 后 type-A 仍差 5–9×，差距属架构性；连贯性探针显示 cover/transport/homotopy 的交换性与非规范间隙精确为 0，而 transport-attention 为 1.54±1.39，说明结构性连贯是精确的、习得的连贯脆弱；顺序敏感度上 transport 区分 80% 的仅顺序不同的词对，Transformer 仅 40±16%。
AI.conclusion: 本文把组合泛化重新表述为「在商上的函子性」：源范畴不是输入的自由幺半群，而是已按任务代数律完成等价的呈现结构，每条律由一个学习到的同伦（自然变换）实现；HIT 规格则提供了这类架构的系统来源。由此形成「指定—验证—编译—训练」流水线，把保证从事后权重验证转为架构级、参数无关的保证（作者称其为首个由机器验证证明为神经架构提供组合泛化保证的实例），并提出从 HIT 声明自动生成硬约束层与训练脚本的编译器愿景。需注意的局限：形式化只覆盖 Torus/Wedge/TransportCoherence/NonCompositionality 四模块，softmax 权重的严格正性未形式化、克莱因瓶关系与证明项 H 尚未形式化（需扩展含逆元的词类型与同伦边界条件）；理论只处理单基点的 π₁ 约束，π₂ 以上的高阶同伦群与带非平凡 0-骨架的 HIT 留作未来工作；实验仅用三个较简单 π₁ 的空间（更高亏格曲面将更严格地检验 H），且因任务为连续几何生成、与 SCAN/COGS 方法不可直接比较（作者称跨范式比较属「范畴错误」）；环面上 transport 解码器仅读取绕数对 (n_a,n_b)、未真正探测词序，故该实验的复合性证据相对薄弱，一致性探针中「复合间隙」列亦受重采样索引偏移污染（架构信号主要来自精确为 0 的交换性/非规范列）。总体评价：核心贡献是把「架构必须保证组合律」从经验主张转为可构造、可形式化、可检验的架构设计原则，代价是适用范围目前局限于单基点 π₁-层面的连续几何生成任务。

title: Learning to Predict, Discover, and Reason in High-Dimensional Discrete Event Sequences
comment: PhD dissertation, 131 pages of main content, 202 pages in total
summary: Electronic control units (ECUs) embedded within modern vehicles generate a large number of asynchronous events known as diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs). These discrete events form complex temporal sequences that reflect the evolving health of the vehicle's subsystems. In the automotive industry, domain experts manually group these codes into higher-level error patterns (EPs) using Boolean rules to characterize system faults and ensure safety. However, as vehicle complexity grows, this manual process becomes increasingly costly, error-prone, and difficult to scale. Notably, the number of unique DTCs in a modern vehicle is on the same order of magnitude as the vocabulary of a natural language, often numbering in the tens of thousands. This observation motivates a paradigm shift: treating diagnostic sequences as a language that can be modeled, predicted, and ultimately explained. Traditional statistical approaches fail to capture the rich dependencies and do not scale to high-dimensional datasets characterized by thousands of nodes, large sample sizes, and long sequence lengths. Specifically, the high cardinality of categorical event spaces in industrial logs poses a significant challenge, necessitating new machine learning architectures tailored to such event-driven systems. This thesis addresses automated fault diagnostics by unifying event sequence modeling, causal discovery, and large language models (LLMs) into a coherent framework for high-dimensional event streams. It is structured in three parts, reflecting a progressive transition from prediction to causal understanding and finally to reasoning for vehicle diagnostics. Consequently, we introduce several Transformer-based architectures for predictive maintenance, scalable sample- and population-level causal discovery frameworks and a multi-agent system that automates the synthesis of Boolean EP rules.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇博士论文（University of Augsburg，2026），核心思想是把车辆诊断故障码（DTC）序列视作"高基数离散事件语言"，用同一套预训练自回归 Transformer 骨干贯穿三部分工作：Part I 的预测性维护（CarFormer、EPredictor、BiCarFormer），Part II 的因果发现（OSCAR、CARGO、TRACE），Part III 的多智能体自动规则合成（CAREP），形成从原始事件流到人类可读诊断知识的可扩展流水线。
AI.motivation: 现代车辆 ECU 产生海量异步离散事件（DTC），其唯一码数量级与自然语言词汇量相当（数万级），而汽车厂商仍依赖领域专家手工用布尔规则把 DTC 组合成更高层的错误模式（Error Pattern, EP），成本高、易错、难扩展。传统统计方法（如互激 Hawkes 过程需 O(|X|²) 参数、经典因果发现算法 PC/GES/LiNGAM 只能处理数十到数百变量）在高基数、长序列、大样本下无法扩展。同时仅有预测精度不足以支撑安全关键场景，必须解释"事件为何发生、如何相互影响"；而纯 LLM 缺乏因果结构约束会幻觉，纯因果发现又缺乏语义与可解释性。此外 DTC 序列本身的歧义（共享相同布尔规则的 EP）也需额外模态来消歧。
AI.method:
论文按"预测 → 因果理解 → 推理"三部分递进组织，统一复用预训练自回归模型作为神经自回归密度估计器（NADE）。

Part I（预测）：CarFormer 为解码器式自回归 Transformer，融合事件类型嵌入、绝对时间嵌入、里程嵌入（上下文嵌入 CE=T+M）并在投影后的 Q/K 上加 RoPE，采用 Next-Event 交叉熵 + 下一事件间隔时间的 Huber 损失 + Random Event Head（注入随机事件、判别真伪）三任务联合训练；EPredictor 以 CarFormer 隐状态作 K/V 做交叉注意力（"dtc2ep"多标签序列分类），联合预测"哪个 EP"（BCE）与"何时发生"（Huber 回归），并提出 CPMW（Confident Predictive Maintenance Window）及其曲线下面积 CPMW_ζ 作为早期自信预测的评价协议。BiCarFormer 为双向多模态 Transformer，用 ViLBERT 式 co-attention 让 DTC 序列与环境条件序列互相注意，环境值经 Greenwald-Khanna 变体离散化分箱。

Part II（因果发现）：以 CMI 为因果打分，OSCAR 从单条序列恢复每个标签的 Markov Boundary（样本级）；CARGO 用自适应频率融合把样本级图聚合为总体级全局图；TRACE 通过随机化中介事件的 do-operator 模拟受控直接效应，用广播张量"阶梯"结构在一次前向传播中并行检验所有候选边，稀疏变体将记忆从 O(N(L−c)L|X|) 降为 O(N·m·L|X|)。理论上给出 CMI 估计误差与模型交叉熵 ε 的界（Theorem 2）、ε-强忠实性下的可辨识性引理与健全性定理。
